1. RETROSPECTIVE REMEMBRANCES FROM 1864 TO 1870

MS 1.2 – pp. 1-34

Oh, what beautiful and great things you showed me in my contemplation of 1864! 1 I would like to write so many things, but I shall always repeat: if my Jesus wanted it, he would certainly make me move my pen to his liking; he would give me an angelic prompt, so that I may be able to describe what I see and what I feel. Firm in that resolve, I set to work, certain that I shall not write anything but that which my Beloved suggests.

Contemplation of the mystery of the Blessed Trinity

Great beyond all words is the sacrosanct Triad infinite one God alone, in three persons, Father, Son and Holy Spirit, equal in their unity, perfect in their Trinity. God alone sees himself as a single person, and promptly sees himself in Jesus and in the Holy Spirit.

Gazing at the excellence and perfection of these three persons, one person and three can always be seen without being divided.

My Love! Great mystery! Oh, that you could make yourself known to the whole world!

You, if one can say such a thing are mad about human beings, and them? 2 Alas! A voice said to me:

  • Yes, I love them, || but my love is unrequited.

In telling me this, he came so close that I felt enraptured. Oh, sanctifying Spirit, divine essence, always ready to pour yourself into the thankless hearts of human beings! What a precious nectar and if only all mankind could taste it! Oh, sweetness without compare! Oh, to whoever can taste and possess this divine Essence, all earthly things are certain to seem disgusting. Once the intellect is unlocked by divine virtue, it is in touch with its immortal Being and in that infinite ocean of infinite greatness understands everything; it rejoices and in love delights. Oh, how infinite you are in your despotic, absolute power and you are Father and beloved Bridegroom of our hearts. Oh, strength of loving souls and of those who live in you and for you!

On 28 May, meditating, alas, I felt a fire increasing slowly, and reasoning I said to my Good: What are you doing, my Beloved? Have you forgotten my wickedness? You fill me with your treasures, and what more can I give you? 3 I have already given you all I had || and because I am a poor creature, having given it all – life, will, everything – I have nothing left.

The creature before the greatness of God

Oh, how small a creature is compared to your infinite greatness! Nothing and less than nothing; it is limited only to one thing, in itself it is stinking flesh, only the soul that is a portion of you, my Good, yearns to return to its centre, that is my Being.1 What is the remaining? A handful of dust. Oh, what a misery, destruction, annihilated I see myself, I would not dare to call “work” but a very small thing, or rather less than nothing.

Reasoning like this I was absorbed in him, and I was enraptured into the highest ecstasy. I saw great and infinite things; my Beloved seemed pouring upon me something that I cannot express. He taught me important things and gave me explanations I had asked him. Oh, how much willingly I could have stayed! (The episode of the three tents).2

But when I 4 came back to my senses I turned || around and I saw nothing but nastiness. Oh, within myself I repeated: Where are you my Good? I had such infinite delight, seeing magnificent things; my Jesus dazzling, and what did I feel? Oh, my Love, only you could say it!

Intimate light and knowledge of hearts

I was meditating on the Blessed Virgin: what I felt! I was taken to contemplate her beauty, her power and the love she has for us poor and miserable creatures. Oh, my light, how much you showed me today! And I stayed in my Good.

Another time I was meditating on the Passion of Jesus in the garden. Oh, what I felt! I was enraptured and my Love made me hear his voice when he prayed, the groan and the weeping. My God, dear infinite love, Essence of my life, what I felt!

I kept for long time that voice in my ears; it seemed to me that I always heard him and what a pain: it was so deep that I do not know how to describe it. I heard it for a long time. I had 5 always || before me the angel who kept the chalice in his hand. Oh, how I would drink it willingly.

Absorbed in God, I saw my Beloved and the brightness was infinite. He told me many things and I answered him. It was an indescribable conversation. At first, it seemed to me that I had kept many things the way I was told, but when I came to write them I realized I was unable. It is true what St. Paul said that the things are many and infinite and it is not possible to describe them.3 But I repeat, if my Good would like that I write, he would certainly guide my pen and make me write what I saw. This is a sign, that they should not be written. Oh, again I felt something and my ribs were almost rising. Oh, what I felt! Here is my Good, alas, you make me die!

I was not fully unaware; soon I started entrusting to him certain people who were recommended very much to me. || 6 I prayed my Good to grant me and provide those people with whatever they needed; he showed me his mercy. Oh, Love without compare, you are so kind to listen to a poor creature! Oh, my Love, may all be granted faith and light to see you! This is how I reasoned: I desire to know fully the strength of your love and all that it contains.

Oh, what did my dear Beloved do? He enraptured me and I understood everything. When recovered, I exclaimed: Why don’t you leave me always with that light, that infinite knowledge of such high understanding. Here I am again in my littleness and ignorance! At this, he gave me a beautiful lesson, telling me that it would be too much and he would end up being discovered in me, not being able to hide the impetus. “Think – he said – if what you feel could endure for some hours, what || would happen!”

7 Oh, my Love – I answered – you are right!

That is how it ended, but I was full of knowledge, furnished of light, I read clearly in the hearts. There were moments in which I saw everything that passed in the hearts of the creatures. Oh, my Love, now while I write, I feel being consumed! Oh, torment of love, alas, I cannot bear it anymore, pity my Love, pity!

The day of oath-taking before the judges

I had a serious quarrel with a priest, but whatever I did, and was needed to be done, I gave account of everything to the Pope Pius IX, and he told me how I should act. The moment came in which I had to take the oath on what I said in the court. Alas, immediately this word frightened me very much and I was anxious for I have never dared to pronounce it.

How should I say and take the oath? Soon I appealed to Pius IX, so that he may tell me what I should do. 8 He sent a message telling me to take the oath and not to fear, || that he was sending his blessing for me, that I should look at him who was faced with great tribulations and should take courage.

Fortified by such powerful words, I made a good and serious examination and I was serene. In the eve, already my Good started uniting me with him, his closeness delighted me and gave me strength; I could not think anything because love absorbed everything and I needed strength not to fall into rapture. I did all I could to turn aside; I spent the whole night in this manner and also the following day, the day of oath-taking. Oh, my Love, the struggle not to remain absorbed in you, my Beloved, was greater than the thought of the oath!

I answered with such certainty that I did not understand myself, in that drunkenness in which I was. 9 I do not know how to express what || I experienced; a cheerfulness invaded me. At the end I did not know what I was doing because my Good kept on holding me close at him. Oh, what I felt in that morning of oath! I will never, never forget. When it was over, I would have liked to understand what I did, but I thought, I was before the judges. Oh, I was so absorbed in my Love!

Oh, what I felt, wretched me! I do not know how to describe it; I enjoyed it but I am unable to express what I felt.

This state endured the whole day. In the evening I wanted to go back with the strength of my mind upon certain points. Oh, what I suffered! But the next day, my Good, the Being of my life, relieved 10 me in Holy

Communion, uniting me with him. After again I fell into very interesting affairs that gave me much trouble. In this way, in the evening || I felt gloom falling upon me but soon

I threw myself under the feet of my Good who comforted me giving me, a fire that consumed me.4

Mysterious signs, ghosts and anxieties at night

The other night, I saw two globes: first, I saw a small one but it was not shining. It even seemed veiled, dark, and underneath red. It stayed motionless for a long time and then it disappeared. Later, another bigger also veiled but less dark globe appeared to me. The red was brighter and more shining. I did not delay to understand their identity. There were two Daughters of St. Anne who were together in purgatory, and the last big one made me understand that I should relieve the smaller one by recommending her.

Oh, blessed soul, even in the torments you are charitable towards your sisters! Oh, what a beautiful soul! She died for charity as she lived for it. Immediately I did penances for the other and I also offered prayers and Masses. || 11 What sweetness I felt in praying for those souls!

I slept and I heard the voice of the smaller; she told me many things, but I feared that it was a diabolic work or my imagination, because I was sleeping. Then I said:

  • Listen, if whatever you told me and what I saw with my eyes is true give me a sign, and I told her what I wanted.

It did not take long that I received whatever I asked for; I don’t write this because people might be involved and I am afraid of failing in charity.

The other evening, two black beasts appeared to me and other smaller ones left me gloomy; a strong melancholy made me suffer much. The same was for the sight of a skull of a dead person, that moved around me here and there. It gave me pain; it was announcing the death at hand of someone.

12 In these days, I had a strong apprehension and it kept me always worried as || if something terrible, some kind of trouble was nearing. It was such a strong feeling that it exhausted me.

Jesus, my Beloved, does not stop comforting me with caresses and graces. I don’t speak of the fire that I feel, the union, and what I feel in my side; such pain is sweet love which makes me exclaim: I am dying, I cannot bear it anymore! Oh, how many things he does not teach me! Oh, sweet words of my Beloved that I hear with my ears and make me languish of love! Oh, Love!

20 October: this night, I mean last night, while I was about to sleep, I felt I could find relief in it, but a strong shake woke me up; who was it? 13 A big beast with four legs, it was close, a meter distant from me and from its movement it seemed as if it wanted to come upon me; I was lying on my back and what a feeling || I had! Though I am already used to seeing them since they always take new manners and new shapes, they always seem new. Moreover, what they produce in me is always different, one time from the other. I was immovable and frightened. Finally, after some time it disappeared rising towards the roof.

While it lifted itself, it took the shape of a coffin; it left me in a strong melancholy and I went on saying to myself:

Here is news of another death; my God, who is it? Who will be? In this way, I always await sorrowful news. Soon after, another big beast appeared with four big legs like those of a grasshopper supporting a catafalque. Oh, my God, what a pain! 14 I am so much disturbed that all the nerves || seem like many pulled ropes.

While I was thinking who it was, I fell asleep and dreamt of people accompanying a dead person to a cemetery, but I was not able to understand who the person was. I woke up very much weighed down with grief because I was feeling much pain. Alas, what is giving me much pain? It is a sign that it is someone close to me. Oh, what days of purgatory!

Even yesterday evening there was a passage of beasts. Oh, I was already oppressed! The addition of this night of other numerous beasts increased my pain. It seemed to me I was falling asleep and there was shaking and strolling of beasts;

the pain was such that in the morning I was not able to stand on my feet and the gloom gave me torment. There were moments in which I was almost to yield; only the union || with my God supported me. 15 Some moments I was tempted with thoughts of all kinds and was gloomy and melancholy; an anxiety that cannot be described and always a deep unrest foretelling me a terrible storm of persecutions. I entrusted myself fully to my Good, that he may give me strength to bear everything with resignation to please him and that he may keep me tightly holding to him as I was tightly holding the feet of my dear Crucifix and I said: let this pain be for me, as it pleases you, because suffering is life; without suffering it is death. The agony was becoming strong; it was gripping my soul that I felt as if it were under two big sandstones. But I thought that it pleased my Beloved… Oh, what a consolation I felt! I suffer, but my Good is with me and comforts me.

Oh, night of 27! 16 My God! The beasts I had in my room tormented me much; one disappeared, others - big ones, small ones - came. || They gave me great pain because they came very close to me and I did not know how to free myself. When one pile was discharged, there was a shaking from above, the whole night.

As soon as I asked: Who are you? They fell down from the wall, and scrambled from all sides. I had a severe headache that I was not able to stand; they left me very upset; I had no strength to wake up. Alas, my head!

Beloved Jesus – this is what I was able to say – I cannot bear it anymore! A strong grip took me from the side of the heart, that seemed to be breaking my bones and the union with my Good was increasing. Oh, my Love, consume me once; I cannot bear it anymore! How can I live, my Love: there are moments that these ribs become like wax, for the action they had to bear; it is too strong and they cannot bear it.

Oh, if I could say what || I feel on this side! 17 Oh, only God could say it because it is he who supports me and gives me strength in the atrocious spasms! Yes, in suffering there is sweetness such that it cannot be expressed.

“Oh suffering, how pleasurable you are!”

Today I had such caresses from my Love that I cannot express; he left me with peace and serenity of mind that I see everything clearly; everything for his Work. My side and the action of the bones! My Love! You make me die, exquisite sweetness!

It is easy to carry the dear yoke of the Lord; beat that I do not feel anything; it is only this pig that feels because it is rotten, I delight without compare, beat! All the suffering of the world put together is nothing in comparison to your sweetness, my Love!

Today, what a consolation or rather, what atrocious torment my soul felt! 18 I was meditating and I stayed on the wound of the back on the right side where the cross || tortured cruelly the holy flesh. Oh, my Love! So much was the weight and shoving that they removed the flesh until the bone. With my mind I sought to penetrate into the pain my Good underwent, and I would have liked to suck the most blessed Blood and cure the wound. While I was staying this way I was then enraptured in God; I felt as if my lips were right on the wound of the back, but what a deep sorrow I felt!

I saw that wound, all torn, the bone was visible. In the maximum torture that I was feeling, I asked him:

  • Am the one I who caused this suffering?

  • No – he answered.

He showed me a bundle of crosses and said:

  • No one wants to carry them.

  • Give them to me, I will carry them willingly.

He answered:

  • You have enough.

When I recovered, I could not stand the pain for the vivid sight of the wound that remained in me; the bone – I went on saying within me – the bone was uncovered, what a pain! 19 It made me weep much. How can I amend? || In my weeping

I always said:

  • Can’t I heal you anymore? Can’t I do anything to alleviate you from such cruel suffering? I cannot bear only by thinking about it! And I was unable to hold back the tears. After much weeping and pain, I remained absorbed in him and he showed me that my weeping had healed his wound. I remained very absorbed and always saw that my suffering healed my Good.

As I recovered, I was full of joy and of cheerfulness; sweetness invaded me. Oh, how willingly I would have disciplined myself until bleeding to the last drop, and I had very little. But I refrained, fearing that it was not the will of God, doing everything that his obedience ordered me. 20 I had much desire of flagellating this flesh for I was not feeling very much the penances I was carrying; || though there were some going into the flesh and I was feeling the flesh decaying as that of my arms. But I must confess that suffering is too sweet for me.

Oh, suffering, how sweet you are! My side was sharing in such a union; oh, my ribs!

I was exhausted. When I recovered from ecstasy then I felt all the painful movements of the bones. Alas, my Love, you are killing me!

These are the words which I always say. Oh, sweet Love! Oh, painful nights!

How much those bad beasts made me suffer I cannot express. They were of all types; among them there was a very big one: its back was in the shape of a ladder. As soon as I fixed my eyes on it, it started running on the wall and then it disappeared. Looking at it brought me a certain feeling for it was empty and in the shape of a ladder. Even the form of the others, foretold to me painful events were to take place. ||

21 That horrible 31st March 1868

The 31stof March, 1868 was horrible because… supported by a Daughter… I received horrible accusations. What I suffered for 24 hours cannot be described. I reached the community at midnight for being called unexpectedly to Sampierdarena, where the tribulations of that foundation were horrible, and the trials were without equal. What I suffered, my Good could say it! Being close to relatives, with the duty of hiding all the fears; moreover I had Alessandro who risked losing a leg and was in Genoa in my father’s house.

I received a fulminating letter from Piacenza: that I should go there immediately. I left everything and ran to listen. I left the poor superior who was weeping, and all alone

I reached Piacenza at 11.30 pm. They almost did not want to open for me; as soon as I entered I searched for the superior but I was told:

  • She is in bed.

Since I did not have the key to my poor room I went to her and asked her:

  • What is the matter? Are you sick?

  • No.

I saw everything as a mystery.

  • 22 Is there anything wrong? - I don’t know anything.

  • Why are you so || upset like this, what happened?

  • Nothing – I was answered.

Only the cook was coming closer to me; in an act of compassion, she said:

  • Poor Mother!

And this disturbed me even more. I said:

  • I feel very cold, is there any room where I can rest?

  • I was answered:

  • You go and rest in the guest room.

I went to the church, but in that agitation something which disturbed me, yet I do not know. Finally, I was able to pray hoping to find some comfort and a word from my Good.

Nothing. I was arid and dry as a trunk. I threw myself with my arms open on the platform and beseeched my Love to tell me something; nothing. What a pain of death! Finally it was morning; I received the Holy Communion and… nothing. At the end of everything, I went to the superior – it must be noted that before she loved me with all her heart and what she did when she was seeing me were big things. I said to her:

  • What is the matter? Speak. I don’t know! How, where is Mr. Tornatore? When is he coming? He called me and he does not come?

She answered:

  • He will never come.

  • How come, what is the matter? ||

  • 23 I don’t know.

I sent to call him, telling him that I arrived. He answered me with a letter. Alas, am I damned?

I seemed stupid, I understood nothing, my head was empty, and my mind was not able to think at all, the intellect was taken away from me. I entered the church; I threw myself with my head on the platform: “Eternal Father, my poor head, pity!”

I do not know how many times I did it; in this way I reached the door of the church. My God, why have you forsaken me? And nothing more. An interior peace reigned in me, but I had no intellect to reason. At the end, after calling him many times, Mr. Tornatore sent a message telling me that he will come in the evening, but he would not come down alone; he wanted to talk to me in the parlour.

He came. He prohibited me from receiving me the Holy Communion and he told me a small portion of the invented accusations they made against me. Immediately I wept a bit and then knowing what it was, I remained serene; but the thought that for fourteen and half years I never failed receiving Holy Communion, what a pain!

24 I obeyed; but in the evening finally in my poor room I scourged || this monster of a body, but I was always cool or rather unable to think and to reason; the intellect was completely non-functional. The next day I went to the church and when the moment of Holy Communion arrived, to see the one who committed the crime moving to receive the Holy Communion and me … I was strongly shaken and went out of the church and went into a room because I was feeling sick. The poor cook came close and I fainted in her arms…

At nine the record started, as I knelt in the confessionalbox. Mr.Tornatore started one… and read a record which lasted until noon; then he restarted again at one and stayed until three when it finally ended. While he read I was feeling an indescribable consolation, but in a way that I am not able to describe. 25 Certain things I did not know even existed in the world; certain dirty things which they accused me of having said, and afterwards the devil || disturbed me, because I did not know what they were and it always brought them…

Oh, what infernal pains, my God!

At this point it happened that the cook having not seen me taking food for twenty-four hours, came and finding me always in the confessional-box, she felt remorse within her and she said that she wanted to speak with Mr. Tornatore.

She started weeping and said:

  • I know everything, poor Mother. They wanted to throw her out and to undo the house and they wanted me to run away with them. I know everything, the Mother is innocent!

Another one who was there… in the confessional-room ran to where Mr. Tornatore and I were, and weeping:

  • Oh, what have I done! The Mother is innocent; it is the superior who led me to write!

And she threw herself to the ground near me with open arms weeping:

  • Forgive me!

I embraced her.

  • I always forgive you; you did nothing to me!

But the superior never! They were five sisters.

Father Tornatore called the superior coldly, as if nothing had happened and both presented to 26 me the accounts to be paid. I was already allowed to receive Holy Communion.

Out of God’s mercy I had collected || some money. I hardly started to speak before this ugly and disgraceful humanity started weeping. This was the second time in my life to weep like this; a strong fit made me to sob so much that I was unable to control it. But as soon as Mr. Tornatore gave me the freedom to stand up, I escaped to my room; I closed the door and wept for about three hours embracing my Crucifix. My God, my Love, what slanders! Where and why did they do it?

If I could describe what I heard being said and what horrendous things passed in these forty-eight hours it would be incredible, because they were horrendous. A wild beast would have been treated much better. Always without eating, I had the strength to stay until noon of the next day. But in the morning I received Holy Communion which gave me strength so that I could say: ”Being of my life” because I was not || the one who lived but my Good lived for me.

27 The greatest pain was, at first the accusations, but later on they were my consolations because they were all false, especially when I received the letter which threatened me… Oh, if Jesus would have not taken away the intellect, what would this monster of humanity have done?

Oh, my Love, it is only you who have seen what this servant of yours suffered! At night, little by little, I felt coming back to myself the capacity to reason and think; a sweetness that delighted me with its fire, my Love consumed me. I complained:

  • Where were you? You left me alone in the terrible battle!

  • I have been always with you.

  • Oh, how could I resist – I thought – yes, dear Jesus, but a word!

This was what I said weeping, because of the strong sobbing throughout the night, I did not weep, but every now and then it seemed to me as if my breast were breaking.

This was what my Good made me understand;

  • 28 If I did not take away from you || the capacity to think, you could have run away; and the children? The relatives? The other house where you left so dear sisters who needed comfort?

At last, certainly you would have not remained, and my Work? And you?

  • Oh my Love, I thank you, have pity on me if I lament! Oh what a consolation I felt! What sweetness he gave me! That is the fruit of suffering!

This year, it seems that my Good chose it for suffering with these kinds of persecutions, having gone through five big ones, not like this but all cruel enough. One was so strong that I was reduced to the extreme; the oil of the sick had already been ordered for me and the priest came to my room ready to give me. But a dear daughter who was fond of me did not allow it; in that year she was the superior and took the place of that unfortunate of whom I spoke above.

29 The doctor gave up hope because he feared the cephalic;

my head was all swollen and I had neither pulse rate nor knowledge. || The pain was so strong that I was overcome; I fainted and I stayed like that. The prayers of the dear sisters and their cries were granted by God because the doctor found that the water had disappeared. What a grace, my Love!5

Sufferings and fire of love in the years 1869 - 1870

Beginning from 1868 continuing the whole year of 1869, there was an artificial fire on all sides and I was alone without comfort. In 1870, the sufferings were less frequent and I had a respite. The thought of what the Church suffered was most painful to me, and at times I fainted, because the pain was very acute. The head of the Church imprisoned, Pius IX, my father!6 Oh, how terrible! Finally, on all sides I found a sight of suffering. I always have a terrible unrest, I always feel like fainting, and I agonize. What will happen my Good? Do you leave me like this? Have you nothing to tell me? The gloom was deep within me and I struggled not to be noticed. If there is something of comfort, I am not able to feel it, nothing comforts me || 30 because these consolations are accompanied by many sorrows. They always give me thought and I am not able to taste anything. Only one thing comforts me; that I have no grudges left in me towards the ones who caused me much pain, and to whom might belong the fault, I feel great affection towards them. I had increased my prayers for them and I had always tried to do that good which I was able to do. When I think about it, I really feel something and go on saying: This is not your stuff, disgraceful monster, but of my Love, because my nothingness would give back what it has.

Oh, my Love, I am truly unworthy to have such an infinite grace! 31 To my Good, this was not enough; for all the slanders they made, he showed up very much the innocence with facts and proofs. Every moment one rose up in defense, but very beautiful || that many times I tell him: My Love, it is enough, no more. Oh, what did I have? Only my Crucifix, from him I took my beakful and the donkey was leaving! I had never done anything and I am good for nothing; only the patience and the love of my God sustained me and through the fury of blows, I understood for I am very hard in understanding. Oh, how much you struggled my Love, have pity on me!

For some days the side of my heart was raised much. The ribs have risen more than usual because the union has been strong; where there is the scar, not that one made by my Crucifix, but that one he made me on the side seems opening. The fire burns.7

I saw the Holy Mother veiled. Oh, what a pain I felt for two days! Always as I looked at her – I mean the picture – I saw her draped with a veil. Oh, what a torment! After two days I saw her again as usual, without the veil. I prayed to her insistently to tell me something.

A sad voice said to me:

  • Rome and the great troubles!

32 Seeing the Holy Mother this way how much melancholy and worry I felt! || How much pain it brought me! I always feared not doing well, that she might not be pleased, because the affection I have for her is great and I see it pleases Jesus.

Oh, my dear Love! Last night what did I feel! Sometimes with the Child… I felt that I was in an atmosphere of paradise. When I recovered, I wept for the sinners and for myself because I am the worst of all. I felt painful and fainting; however it is not me who live but you, my Good!

A voice suggested to me new penances. Poor me, could it be my Good, or the ugly monster? It continued until ten and I was not able to resist.

I made a request to my God: if you order me this, sustain me, because I am depressed and I fear this skeleton might succumb. If it is your will, I am happy! 33 Soon he gave me proof making me feel much sweetness and his love || which consumed me. In this way Father Bernardo appeared to me.

Oh, what I felt, my God! What a happy night! Only that at daybreak putting on the instruments, I was so exhausted of strength, I could not stand. And yet I was cheerful. What could I do? Again I lay on the cross. Oh, I was absorbed in ecstasy in my Good and he filled me with strength. As soon as I was enraptured it happened that I felt snatched from me, from the side of the heart, something I do not know.

Immediately I found myself in him and it seemed to me that I flew into the tabernacle. Oh, my Love!

As I recovered, full of strength, I woke up and went for meditation together with the community. Oh, what sweetness in that meditation! 34 I looked at the Holy Mother and I saw her beautiful, very cheerful; after I asked her if the providence had arrived; she told me || that it will arrive. I had such a peace, a certainty that comforted me much.

Later certain sadness came upon me unexpectedly and soon I ran to the church to see how the Holy Mother was: I found her always beautiful.

2. EXPERIENCES SHE HAD FROM 1871 TO 1874

MS 1.2 – pp. 34-62

An angel with a chalice: “You must swallow it all”

34 On 30 January, a very big angel appeared to me with an azure mantle and a pale blue belt, and the most beautiful shoulder-band of gold. He gave me three little pieces of bread to eat. Oh, how delicious they were!

I must say that I was extremely weary and it seemed to me that I was dying, alone in my room. I entrusted my soul and prayed to Jesus that he may receive it in his bosom; I so abandoned myself that I thought it would be a short time before I expire. That is, when the angel appeared to me and comforted me for I was suffering. When I finished eating the bread he showed me a full cup and he said to me:

  • You must swallow it all.

And again I fell into such agony, that I could not speak; I felt only a passionate desire to drink it up, while it seemed to 35 me he was holding it for me to drink. I fainted and stayed resting against his shoulder. || I had not completely lost my senses for I felt him pressing the cup to my lips as though I would drain it to the last drop.

  • You must swallow it all, is what he said.

As I recovered he disappeared and I was alone as someone who is still between sweetness and suffering, but very much strengthened. I was no longer feeling weary and I lay down; I slept but always as if I still had that angel next to me. I felt him throughout the day, always with him and I was asking him to tell me something. Oh, the following night, what a terrible night! What a battle, what cruel torments the enemy made me experience. It was throwing me here and there: now it seemed to me that the infernal abyss was opening for me and it brought me every kind of suggestion and torment. I was deprived of any human help;

what could I do? The most horrendous figures were coming forward; I saw nothing, where could I escape? I called my Beloved and … nothing. Alone, I was alone, oh, my Crucifix! Every minute different ghosts and suggestions, horrible figures, pains all over the body and || of every kind!

36 I was tightly clinging to the Crucifix: nothing. Finally I lay down on the cross; it seemed to me that the chains I had put on, especially the big one, were choking me because I was very swollen. I was feeling the breaking of the skin and the flesh which gave me horrendous torments; the scars were all open. Oh, my Love, I am dying. It was a torture of hell and the enemy continued its action that brought me greater pain than the sufferings. In this way lying on the cross, I abandoned myself; the suffering was stronger than the strength that my God gave me and since he did not come to my help I fainted. I do not know after how many hours I recovered and there was nothing in me; I found myself as one who returns from death to life. I looked around and asked: where are you, my Beloved? Am I still alive?

“Mary: This knife is yours!”

Today, however, I drag myself to my feet and furthermore

I had a new suffering that pierced me and it seemed to me that a knife pierced || my chest. 37 I cried: Mary, what a pain, this knife is yours!

What a torture! I wept, but I felt calm, a peace and nothing. I could only overthrow myself; and though I felt depressed, I undertook to discipline myself until bleeding, until I fainted. Then I put myself in the hands of my Love and feebled in this way I said to him: do with me whatever you want. I was incapable of desiring or feeling anything, I was very abandoned. There my Good presented to me a cross that was not very big, but sufficiently big. Oh, my God, what a horrendous state is this! One lives and does not know of living; there is inability to feel because the soul is so drowsy… Where am I? How am I? What will happen to me? Exhausted I lay; I thought I could fall asleep but I was halfasleep. 38 I heard a strong sound which woke me up and turned towards the side where it was coming from; it was from where the cross stood. I saw a red dog; || it started barking and gave two or three cries and then it disappeared. Who can it be? But serene I lay to sleep. Not at all! That sound always remained within me; when I woke, what unrest, what a pain! I did not know where I was: My Love, where are you? You always leave me in the midst of such cruel pains; I feel like dying, have pity!

I was feeling so weak that not bearing it I threw myself to the ground – something which I usually do - my God, what life is this? Oh, suffering yes, but with you my Love; without you everything is unbearable to me. My Being, what desolation! I find myself in darkness and confusion, I understand nothing. I cannot even weep, which would relieve me; not even this, I am like a trunk, and I do not know why my Good left me. Oh, they are my infamies that caused this! Oh, what a terrible day the 16 of February! I felt all kinds of tribulations.

39 After many days of such a cruel || state, suddenly my Good came; a fire that burned me and the side was raised up so much for the union I had with my Good and on that side I could bear nothing. It was a severe pain: My Love, have pity on me!

Today in looking at the Holy Mother, I saw her veiled again: the pain, the anxiety, the thought … what will ever happen, my God! What will happen, dear Mother? The silence always gives me pain! In this way when she appears to me sad and she does not tell me the reason I experience horrendous sufferings.

Corporal penitences pleasing God and Mary

Date 30 (…) of 1871. For three months I had two iron bars strapped to my arms and they are so ingrown that they give me atrocious spasms of pain. Oh, what a pain! Every movement is a torture; just resting my arm to write, what agony, my Love! You could certainly say better than me the intensity || of this suffering. 40 I did not have the courage to remove them. How could I? The pain was increasing all around the flesh; should I ask someone? Oh, better to die earlier. But the wicked serpent told me that I would have to pay for it if I were to die like this. While I struggled thus, the pain stopped, as if the iron bars were removed. I looked, they were still there I did not feel pain of any kind anymore. I was able to work with strength as if I never had them; I felt nothing. And it seemed to me that it was God’s will and thought no more of removing them. Oh, wicked flesh, if I could chop you to please my Good! My strength had decreased much, that is why I was able to give myself only

600 beatings of discipline until bleeding while the other years and even last year, on Good Friday, I had 1,600. Oh, how weakened are you ugly beast || of body!

41 Oh, my Love, I find myself in the worst afflictions; come my Love to comfort me! He came to console me. I was offering my penitences as he taught me telling me that he appreciated them. I used to do this every now and then, but not according to the way he taught me. The reason for which I abstained was that I saw myself as a shapeless monster and what I did was not sufficient to cover my iniquity; moreover it was such a misery to offer it to my Beloved Sovereign that I would feel ashamed. He, who is infinite in charity, deigns to accept but desires the offering and invites me to do it and he showed me that he appreciated it very much. Oh, what a goodness of a God! I did the offering of these miseries one by one and almost at the end I stopped to gaze at the image of the Eternal Father sighing. || 42 In this way interiorly I was asking him why he did not send me providence. With a strong voice he said to me:

  • The only vow that you renewed and finally professed to my daughter Mary is enough for you to have my providence always.

He showed me how Mary was pleased with that sacrifice and rejoiced for the renewal. Because of false motives and led by my guide I ate fruit, while for eight years I had made a strict vow to Mary not to eat it. It could be said that they forced me, telling me it was for my health!

It was true that I ate, but few times and always with certain remorse; I was told that obedience was better, but I said:

  • Does obedience remove vows?

It is enough, I gave in and I am always convinced that I could have avoided it. Today I find myself in confusion of a thousand sorrowful thoughts. 43 Two days ago, I injured the bones while I was || on the cross; I felt spasmodic pains and they were so cruel that they brought me fever. I felt lost. To whom should I tell? To Mr. Tornatore? Oh, never! He would certainly tell me to go for a visit and worst he would upset my poor mind.

  • What if I become worse? Within myself I went on saying – should I speak, yes or no? Jesus, tell me what I should do. In this way I lamented while laying down on the cross; something woke me up and opening my eyes, I saw a very beautiful globe of fire and from inside it I heard the voice of my Good whom I saw after; he caressed me and I was healed. But instead of thanking him – I must say that I was in great anguish – I turned away my face and I said:

  • I do not need your caresses: if you do them it is because tomorrow there will be new terrible sufferings.

My God, forgive me! 44 I was assailed by a terrible restlessness, I had || something unbearable, I suffered cruel tortures. With much struggle I recommended myself to God, that he may have mercy, that he may beat me but never leave me in such a cruel state. Forgive me my God, my Love, I almost dare not to call you with this name! What did I do? Forgive me.

With the pain that I felt at that moment the devotion was added and I continued to pray more deeply. The battle was hard; I was prostrating on the ground, humiliated to the deepest of my nothingness and with a very intense suffering.

Finally, right now I feel being in peace and the thought that soon I will see my Love to give me more strength. I feel couragious enough that I could face any kind of pain and injury that could come upon me. I complained gently asking him to continue healing a sick person who seemed almost healed but had relapsed. He gave me explanations.

My dear Eternal Father, my beloved Love, how good you are towards a disgraceful creature! ||

45 “To suffer and to enjoy infinitely the delights of the Beloved”

On the night of 20 August 1874 and the whole of the following day, my God! The union with my Beloved was such that I always went on exclaiming: Alas, I am dying!

The fire burned me; my Love came so close to me that I was always worried that they could realize something. But when it was possible I retired and then… Oh, what have I ever experienced!

I was taught certain things I had to do. He instructed me on his love, its degree and how he communicates it to the soul, but I am unable to repeat everything. I feel to have the things clear, as he told me, but I am unable to describe them.

I saw immense things, great without compare; how the soul must be well purified in order to receive this love. In this, one feels burning, consumed as the ardent longing to be consumed grows. Oh, incomprehensible mystery!

To suffer and to enjoy infinitely the delights of the Beloved;

always wanting him only and for him everything is little. Yes, my Love! || 46 The fire was increasing in me so much that I was not able to stand up; for fear of being noticed I went to my room. When I was locked, “My God, I feel like fainting! If they do not see me, they will throw down the door.”

I threw myself, stretching down in the ground: “My Love

I am dying!” Recovered, I immediately bathed the side and the hands and I felt relieved; but it was not enough.

I disciplined myself until bleeding and I scourged myself as long as my strength allowed me. Immensely exhausted I fell down to the ground; this is how the donkey should be!

Night ghosts. The voice of her dead child

The night of 24 August, after midnight while I lay down as usual, I felt as if I fell asleep; I was shaken: I saw a big beast with white spots at its back. 47 While I was about to ask who it was, what it wanted, what would happen to me, it ran away and fell down. || But it left me a palpitation; I did not know how to find a way to rest. My God, what will happen to me? It seemed to me as if I was falling asleep when I had another shaking. A big beast was outside the window on the glasses; I looked at it and it looked at me. I fainted and again became upset as I was, it seemed to me, to be calm and fell asleep. I felt a certain peace of paradise…

My Love, what should I do to make me stand up? Nothing; I felt the union with my God getting stronger; in this state I heard an angelic voice calling me:

  • Mommy, mommy!

I turned to see from where it came and who it was. I saw the child whom I lost when he was ten months old: “Oh, dear!” I called him by name: Francesco.8 He said:

  • Mother, God wants to give you a big gift.

Having said this he disappeared. What will my Love give me? 48 To me, that I am so disgraceful, unworthy as I am! || What will it be?

Suddenly, I saw a crown but old and ugly! Whose is it? Nothing; it disappeared. Thinking what meaning it might have I fell asleep. But what a shaking! Again there was a beast, such that I could not sleep at all and I was very tired.

Before I stood up – it was odd – a wind blew but only in the room; it blew even on my face and in the whole room; it raised me from the pavement. I even saw a letter from Rome addressed to me. Who could it be? What restlessness, it was a real purgatory, and more so because I had no clear explanations; it disgusted me and I was feeling something that kept me restless. It was a real martyrdom, my Good! But if you are happy, even me I am happy for doing what you desire.

It was true that the explanations did not delay, because I always had tribulations. ||

49 “I am abandoned by my Good, alone!”

On the night of 27 August, what pain I felt! That ugly, the whole night did nothing other than rocking the metal of the bed where I slept. It rocked me on the cross, what a pain! It brought me a trembling in the nerves that I was completely shaking. While I was thinking, a very black beast with long legs one different from the other appeared to me. On the head it had a miter of a Bishop and on the miter a big thorn, very long but with no point, it seemed that someone had beaten it because it could be seen that it was fixed again. On the back it had another frightening point and a terrifyng long tale vibrating towards me; I was able to say anything for the shape struck me very much. I was silent for a long time; I forced myself and with my thought I turned to my Good and I felt relieved. I took courage and I said:

Who are you? What do you want to say?

50 Immediately as I pronounced this || it disappeared and it left something in the room, as it happens when people run away, that uproar…

Alas, my Love, what will happen to me? My throat tightened and I remained in a horrible state without any relief. What pains my God! After staying like this for some hours, worn out, I tried to sleep: no, again worse than before;

a thousand sounds, shadows of women who wanted to beat me. I was very upset and I would have liked to find relief from my Good. But nothing! I tried to call him, but I had to struggle so much that at the end I got a severe headache and I could not stand. Oh, is there anything more for me? I am abandoned by my Good, alone! Where are you my Beloved? Mary! The next day, in Holy Communion I was very much consoled; tightly holding my Good, I was absorbed in him. He is my master, my Being; I had him close with me and on my face I felt his hair.

51 I was nourished with immense strength; || he instructed me in hidden things; he gave me beautiful lessons, but how can I write them? I am unable. If he wished he could have taught me; it means that I must not write more than this.

The next day, again after Holy Communion, he appeared to me and rebuked me sweetly on an act of humility (that is what it seemed to me externally). He said to me:

  • This is not the humility which I want.

And he taught me how he wanted it. I answered him:

  • To avoid making a mistake I will never do it.

He answered:

  • No, I want you to follow as I teach you.

I spent two days of paradise, always in him and when I was able to retire to work and was not noticed, soon I was absorbed in my Love.

This night or rather last night the temptations restarted.

Evil suggestions of becoming mad

10 November 1874: I had the most horrible temptation according to my thinking, the most painful and cruel there could be that of becoming mad.

52 Oh, if I knew how to write all the || suggestions and instigations that the infernal dragon continually brought to me! I could write volumes yet, I have no time. How many things it told me and it showed me that I was mad. It said:

  • Now you are really mad; do you see what foolish things you did? This night, you will certainly throw yourself out the window. You see, your mind had failed you, and you remember nothing!

It took me and showed me that I really was, because in my speech, many times, it locked my tongue, and in this way I said one thing for another. Oh, it came forcefully and said:

  • You are!

What horrible pains! Last night, they were so strong that I fainted: “My God, do with me whatever you wish but do not allow this!”

While I write, I suffer and I pass quickly because it always whispers to me. Oh, what are the beasts, the pains, the tortures I experienced in comparison to this!

Alas, I can love no more my Beloved! Anything else, my Jesus!

53 If I lay down, it || tread the head upon the pillow that seems I cannot move it anymore. I feel spasms as if there were someone choking me and sometimes it pulls out the hair one by one. What a pain, dear Jesus! I remained with a horrendous headache. In the morning I cannot even touch the head; I have much sensitivity that I cannot bear.

If I am thinking about certain aspects of the Work, it tells me:

  • Will you do this when you will be crazy?

If I work or do something, immediately:

  • Will you do it when you will be crazy?

Oh, what a pain! And it says:

  • Do you see that it is already the beginning? Don’t you know that such a person started in the same way? The same will happen to you.

My God, help me – I went on saying within me – I am in full knowledge; it is not feasible that you give to this monster the freedom to torment me proudly. Let it beat me with any kind of martyrdom but … || 54 This is how it continues in these days and nights and only when it tells me many things, then

I raise my voice and I say to it:

  • Ugly dragon, in God’s name, depart from me and come back no more!

It flees, but later, at the first occasion it is ready. It seems that I should laugh. In those moments when God allows it to grieve me, there is no way, there are no facts to rely on; no, our intellect remains so obscured that it cannot help in any way. My poor head seems a Vulcan; it thinks now in one way and after in another. I feel it swelling since it does much of the work the nerves do. The suffering is such that there is no comparison to be made. First, I have a strong convulsion, which I have never had and I do not know what kind this torment is. If I could describe what I feel! 55 Alas, now that I write, it seems that there is a bit of peace. Not all! || It tells me:

  • Write, so that when you will be crazy, they will say that you were already while you wrote.

If I close my eyes for a necessity:

  • Look, this is an act of madness. Look, what you say and do is out of experience and not because of right reasoning.

If I could write what it tells me, I would stay always with the pen in hand and it would not be enough. Oh, in the church, the things that it tells me are horrendous! What tribulations! Oh, if I could have someone to comfort me, to assure me! Oh, horrendous pain, you are more terrible because I am alone on the gallows. My God, you leave me where I am: in an abyss of pains.

It comes from all sides; in recreation it came so strongly that I could not bear it and I fainted. Oh, Eternal Father, come to my help; order the dragon to depart from me!9

56 It left this and it assailed me with a strong temptation telling me that I || thought about indecent things and dwelt on them. I laughed, but it found a means to confuse me, telling me that I was in sin. However, having come out from such a cruel state, this seemed to me a play of children; embracing my Good, I asked him to tell me how the thing was. But coolly, the temptation of being and becoming mad assailed me again: My God, my angel St. Michael, have pity!

You who defended me many times have pity! Come and defend me from such infernal dragon!

Sometimes I felt that there was someone close to me and helped me; I am sure that it was he, because otherwise, I could have not been able to resist.

Infused lights in treating the affairs of the Work

In these days I did not even feel the pain of the penances, but only the pains in the hands, feet and side. 57 I must say that

I have a || relief but it was not enough to rise up my poor tossed soul. This was the second time that I had been assailed by such a cruel sensation and torment without compare;

however, this time it was more painful than the first, because it exhausted all my strength and I remained so shaken.

But the lights to deal with the affairs of the Work of the Lord did not fail me, because this morning, I dealt with a very important affair, very interesting. I did not have the minimum disturbance neither of mind nor of feeling suggestions. Nothing, as if I have never had tribulations.

This because the words were such that I heard them coming out from the mouth of this ignorant woman, who does not know how to say a word unless her Teacher tells her. In this way I heard beautiful words coming out. Oh, my Love, you are with me now; I feel you. Why did you abandon me to such terrible temptations? ||

58 Oh, how much I enjoyed that negotiation! My soul was delighting. Oh, how it went on well; everything was obtained and a beautiful victory was brought.

Oh, my dear Love, how much sweetness your words have! Oh, my Love, do not allow that I fall again in such torments; they are terrible!

I do not know how to express the troubles I feel; oh, that I may never hear this bad word anymore!

I had confessed and I was told that I should answer since obedience does not want absolutely. But what words were these? I did that and it was worse again; I was not serene. Moreover, I had the scruple of not being guided well, even in confessions, because only God knows in what way I find myself alone!

When these temptations of scruples assail me, (I call it like this) what a torment! 59 That one of madness was added to it which was a dread. || A strong throbbing took me. My God I am dying!

“I do not want earthly satisfactions”

I was lying down as usual, but frightened and very much trembling. While staying like this, the devil appeared to me in the form of a stupid person, pulling its face foolishly. My unrest stopped and I started making fun of it saying:

  • Are you the one who torments me?

While I observed, it was doing such foolish things that I could not stop laughing. Then with a resolute voice I said:

  • Go away, filthy, ugly animal; go away, far off, not to return anymore!

After this, it disappeared and I stayed serene all the rest of the night. After two days while I was half-asleep, I was shaken and saw near me a young man. He was very intent on showing me that a religious was bringing accusations against me, and he had already brought big ones. This young man said to me:

  • 60 Do you want that I uncover certain things of his…and I dishonour him? || I can dishonour him and unveil everything in the eyes of the people and make him ugly; unmask everything he did and more so that you can be satisfied.

To hear that I could be satisfied I halted:

  • Here you will be appeased and satisfied – he continued.

Immediately I realized what kind of satisfaction he meant, the earthly satisfaction.

  • No – I said – no, I do not want earthly satisfactions and hurt someone who made me suffer, no, no; I only want that satisfaction from my God and not on this earth but in heaven.

He made a strong squeak and left.

It was true that there were strong inventions and horrendous slanders, and what I felt for these! But I always pray much for him and I do not know what I could do to render him much good.

61 Unexpectedly, I had much consolation and I felt that my Love was pleased with such a reply and that the prayers I did for that priest || were very dear to him. These words filled me with consolation; I stayed very cheerful within me that the work and all the people I met caused me no suffering. As happened the following day (yesterday), while I was talking with two people - one was a priest the other was a woman they purposely came to insult me, they said many things, it was too much. But I delighted in the joys of paradise; I had my God close to me and was telling me what to answer. The more they spoke, the more he himself, my Good comforted me. Oh, my Love! I felt nothing for those insolences;

furthermore, they brought me a certain pleasure. He suggested to me everything I had to reply and I enjoyed very much his words. 62 It was more a union with my Good rather than a battle with those poor people; this is how I called them when I raised my eyes || and met with theirs.

Alas, in those eyes I saw an angry spirit and they would have liked to eat me up, but they could do nothing to me; my Beloved was close to me and I could have challenged the whole world. I repeated what my Good was suggesting to me and from wild lions they became lambs. I saw inside the priest and what he would have liked to say and be understood but he could not. He swung with gestures and movements of head, but he was silent. He had to convince himself, though unwillingly.

Oh, at the end of such a long discussion, I remained as drunk of consolation! My Love, only you and nothing else!

3. EXPERIENCES SHE HAD FROM 1875 TO 1877

MS 1.2 – pp. 62-97

Vision of the Child Jesus

62 From the night of the last day of December until 1st January 1875, what I felt! My God you could dictate me to write it; myself I am unable.

I felt violently to be united with my God and I remained absorbed in him. 63 My little || Love came over and put his hands on my shoulders; he embraced me, spreading his dear arms. But someone came and took him away but at a distance that I could see him because there was much light. However, I was not able to identify the person who took him away. Four times he did the same but the last time I took him in my arms; holding him tightly I kissed him. The same person came in front of me and took him and I saw him no more.

I remained as in ecstasy; I recovered and felt a strong pain.

  • But this is a vision which might have a meaning – I reasoned on my own – what could it be?

The person took him and I saw him no more; 64 who could be that person? I prayed and pleaded with my God that he may tell me something; if there was any small thing that did not || please him: if he could give me a hint I would cut it off. Oh, my Good, I live and breathe only for you! Oh, pain without compare!

I asked him if he wanted another sacrifice from me, but he answered nothing.

The next day I continued in the Holy Communion and I said:

  • Oh, my Love, what do you want? I do not know what to give, because everything is yours! I have no more life because it is yours!

In all truth I can say that I do not feel to be alive but I live in him. Oh, my dear Good!

The pain grew stronger that it seemed I would faint at any moment and life was failing me; for me this suffering was worse than if I had all the sufferings upon me, in all the parts of my bones. But not this absence, my God, my Love!

65 Because of the pains of the wounds and the headache which is always tormenting me, || and I believe it is produced from sleeping on the iron chain for many years, and from the crown; I feel a mute, continued pain.10

She came to know a plan for poisoning her through superior light. St. Michael defends her Last night I saw one of our sisters, a Daughter of St.

Anne, who by diabolic instigation was plotting to kill me. My

Good told me that she would not succeed, that I should be serene because my angel was watchful. But she was not alone;

there was also another one. However, even this would not succeed. He told me not to be worried since if I will be poisoned, the poison will not bring me death but pain. But this disgraceful body was worried. Oh, have pity on me, forgive me for this unrest, I cannot avoid it anymore! How can I make this donkey reason?11

For some days I stayed with such a pang in my chest that I was unable to breathe. The more I beat this wicked body, the more it was restless.

66 This morning, while || I prayed to my angel St. Michael – He was given to me by Jesus to defend me – I said to him:

  • Oh, my dear defender! You, who have defended me a number of times, calm me and be close to me.

Having said this, I saw him near me with his unsheathed sword and he told me that he would protect me always; that I should not fear. Oh, joy! Even now he is beside me. Oh, Love, the fear disappeared and I am full of strength.

I continue, because I was with my Good. Oh, what this angel did for me in certain painful moments of anguish! He supported me, he gave me strength. Oh, Love, what I felt! I felt embracing my Good and he took me in the air, in ecstasy, to enjoy things I cannot describe. I always fear that this may happen when there are people around. But no, what do I fear? 67 My Good had promised me, that || no one would realize.

“You ask for my blood, even though

I do not have anymore!”

After a month that I did not discipline myself until bleeding because I was completely without strength for being sick, I had an impulse to do it. Soon a voice said to me:

  • I desire that during this novena of Christmas you discipline yourself until bleeding every day.

  • Oh, my Love, I am ready! You ask for my Blood even though I do not have anymore. Last time I could offer you only water and small pieces of flesh but I will do it immediately.

I had a strong desire to do it and I waited eagerly for night time; as I prepared myself for the beating I felt great consolation at the thought of giving pleasure to my Love. What sweetness was this for me! Oh, dear Eternal Father! The first beatings were for him and I started. A voice said to me:

  • 68 For the grace you asked, your blood was necessary. ||

I did it with so much violence and for such a long time that all the little blood that I had put on in the month of my rest, I poured all, all.

Exhausted a convulsion took me with a certain twisting of nerves and I thought I was dying. The next day, as soon as I received Holy Communion, I fainted. I recovered but I fainted again. Afterwards I felt a strong cold in the head and I had a fever that shook me. I did not fear, though all were afraid to see me in that state. I knew the motive and certainly Jesus would heal me. Some days have already passed but I still feel spasms and weakness. Suddenly great fears came upon me. Alas, I am alone! 69 Have I done well? ||

Should I do it again? The impulse continued.

  • What if it was the “ceppinello”?12 My Jesus, tell me, what should I do?

Furthermore, for having bitten strongly in some places, the flesh has rotten. Oh, what pain I felt! But these suffering gave me much delight and I was always ready to do it every time that pleased my Good. Who can describe the delight of suffering of this kind? No one, at least this is what I think; because the more I study, I cannot explain it;

what a mystery. Much delight in such horrendous pains!

Again protected by St. Michael

I saw a serious persecution against the Institute and I anticipated the pains which I would suffer when I would be in the battle. I experienced that suffering for about half an hour and it was so much that it seemed to me a century. I felt transported to the Vatican and I brought back a treasure. 70 I saw

|| myself so privileged and happy, I delighted at such a visit.

Impressed at what I saw I stayed the whole day inebriated.

Last night, while I was praying, I saw my archangel

Michael with the sword unsheathed in an act of defending me. Alas, my dear angel, what will happen to me?

Since I am always subject to new fears, I started trembling but it seemed to me that he assured me not to fear: Yes, I do not fear, because your sword is very powerful, but forgive me!

He comforted me and disappeared. I remained full of strength and vigor; I would have faced a thousand arms. I could well say that the life that he makes me live now and for which he gave me strength and makes me languish is his, because it is he who lives in me.

“Do not doubt, I am with you; be serene”

71 On the night of 4 January, while I was lying as usual and praying, I felt something delighting me; at a certain moment there was a beautiful light. I remained as || absorbed by such a sight; unmovable I looked at it while it was spreading and I saw my Eternal All, beautiful without compare, stretching his right hand towards my head in an act of blessing me. There was a big trumpet and from this fire came out: even this was turned towards my head. I cannot describe what I felt. It disappeared and I remained very much absorbed for a long time. As I recovered, it seemed to me that I always saw my Love and enjoyed him as when I was absorbed; such was the impression. Oh, what my side felt!

  • Alas – I continually said – you are killing me!

I spent the night in this way, always with my Good. The next day, my meditation was of union with the Eternal Father; the same was the preparation of the Holy Communion, and again I heard that I will have everything that I desire. I had beautiful lessons, how I should act for his Work, and how to deal with other things. || 72 He told me also what I should do regarding my spirit, so that I would not fall into some hindrances, especially when I am in danger. He told me:

  • Do not doubt for I am with you, be serene.

And he reminded me of certain past doubts he smoothed; he also assured me that the enemy would not touch me.

Vision of Pope Pius IX:

she is not allowed to go near him

The night of 7 January, the dragon came. It took my bed and swung it. It did it so strongly that it seemed it would knock down the bottom of the room, and I was feeling the same impression as if I were really falling down. It was a painful spasm.

After keeping me for half an hour in this state, it disappeared and I remained serene, because while the ugly tormented me, I constantly increased my fervor in prayer.

73 “Oh, my Love, you are always with me, || hold me tightly to your heart.”

The night (…) of the same month, lying as usual I was making a spiritual communion when I fell asleep. I was so tired that I slept – at least I thought – for more than two hours. A shaking woke me, and I felt very frightened with a strong convulsion; I did not know to whom should I turn to.

I would have liked to resist and force myself to see if I could rest at least a bit more, but no way. I turned to my Good, and absorbed in him, I saw Pope Pius IX; I found myself next to him and he comforted me and encouraged me to bear the terrible sufferings of the Work of God. He told me many things that even he himself suffered, and yet he was very happy. While I enjoyed such a conversation, many people came and he addressed them with his cheerful speech but they went away, and the Pope remained sad.

  • Alas, why? – I asked.

74 But he strolled with his || hands at his back. I felt great anxiety. Other people came and they made turmoil; however

I did not understand why they spoke with him who was standing there in that murmur. But they went away and he went on strolling. I ran to meet him; he looked at me with an act of compassion and wanted to speak to me but what did all those people do? They did not allow me, and every time I presented myself they took me impolitely and put me out. As

I recovered, what pain I felt! I always thought: What will happen to me?

Oh, it will be too cruel if I will not be able to hear and see Pius IX! I am very affectionate to him! Oh, pain without compare, oh, for pity’s sake!13

75 But soon my Good granted me || a spiritual grace; all my fears disappeared and I thanked my Love.

Notice for the death of two sisters. “My Francesca”

Many times my God reproaches me because I don’t write what I see and experience. Today, in order to obey, I want to write quickly, as well as I can, what I saw.

In the early days of August, the usual beasts but looking very differently appeared to me. One was in the form of a catafalque and the other one of coffin with a cloth upon it. A great number of other beasts accompanied it and there were certain girls; how I suffered.

I struggled much to know how it was, who they were, but I discovered everything. After, I don’t know, how many days, two beautiful crowns appeared to me; one was inside, the other one was very small. They were stopped together, and where they stopped there was a beautiful star.

  • Alas – I exclaimed again – this is a signal of the deaths of two sisters. One was a superior and the other one perhaps she will die with her. ||

76 What pain, I felt my God! I was not able to know anything. The next day in my thanksgiving, two others were signaled to me that they were to die.

I had such a pain that it seemed to me there were people to announce to me some misfortune. Again always beasts of new form; I don’t even try to ask what they signify because I had found it useless. So I look at them until they disappear.

Many times I had the vision of a very luminous globe and it produced in me good effects; it assisted me. I said to “assist” because it gave light and peace to my soul and in certain things it directed me, though I did not hear the voice.

September: Oh, how the union of the two crowns became true! 77 The event was all explained: the superior, || my dear

Francesca and her secretary died within a few hours.

Dear daughter, your star was beautiful! You have worked for the saint (…). Oh, what a sorrow!

The crown was beautiful and it was for my dear daughter.

The other one was very small but beautiful. You enjoy the fruit of your labour!

My Francesca – I always went saying – how much she will rejoice to see it on her head! Blessed she!14

The devil threatens to throw her out the window

I had strong temptations, horrible, especially one where the monster was telling me:

  • Now, I will throw you out of the window; you will remain in the air and your God will perform a miracle for you.

What a pain! It came close to pick me up and push me down; what a night I spent! It was such that I could not stand the battle anymore. My God, save me. For pity’s sake, come to my help!

Finally, it left me and I said:

  • Oh, if I could take an hour of sleep!

78 I lay down soon, since I was worn out; I thought rest could restore me and I || just slept when I heard a strong blow on the table, which seemed as though it would break the table into pieces. As if that was not enough, also the wall and the window! My God save me, I cannot bear it anymore.

When I said this it diminished and then again, strips of fire. Oh, what a fear took me! I was unable to say anything, then it ceased. But again there were red stripes running in the room. Who is this soul? What does it want?

And I got an answer: it was a soul who was still in purgatory. It left me with a certain headache caused by the confusion; and I suffered horribly. The headache was such that it caused me to faint. Oh, what pains are these, my God! How I remained without strength! I had hardly recovered when again I was taken by my temptation with such violence that I was dying of fear.

79 One afternoon while I was writing in my study room, || I felt a strong impulse to wake up. Thinking that it might be my Good who wanted me to observe something, as happens sometimes, I woke up. Alas, a terrible voice said to me:

  • Now you are out the window.

There was an upsetting in the air; I saw and heard something fall out the window; such sound left me without strength. I was as bewildered by fear but my Love never left me without providing me with his strength.

Ah, infamous dragon, throw yourself down once, never to come back to torment me!

An intimate and strong union with the supreme Good

I remained serene for some time but the monster did not delay to restart, not so strong but enough to torment me. However the night preceding the day of my holy father St. Francis of Assisi I spent completely in paradise and I received great consolations. || I had to take certain 80 (…) and he encouraged me; I had a strong fear that brought me agony. My Good took away my anguish and assured me that it was his will, that he would always be with me, and would help me in everything.

I went to the church to receive Holy Communion; I felt a fire … my side… what I felt my Love! My ribs were rising; the union was so strong that I had to control myself not to fall into ecstasy.

I stayed in him in an intimate union; I enjoyed things that I am not able to express. As I recovered there was a light before me and wherever I went it was always near me; it was very beautiful and it gave me cheerfulness, peace… I felt my Love close to me in the union and I was not bearing it. My ribs on the side of the heart, what a trouble! 81 I felt a very sweet pain. However, I was always watchful not to be absorbed for fear of being discovered. ||

Departure of her son Alessandro to America

Today, my son came to take his leave because he was going to America. I felt the pain because of the thought that

I will never see him anymore was much; but much more painful was the fact that in those countries of depravity he could be lost.

And if unfortunately he could be caught by death, where would he go? He could die without the comforts of the holy Church as a good Christian. It is certain that he could forget my Good and then I could lose him for an eternity. Oh, pain! A creature that belongs to me should not die in the arms of my God? Should I think that this will be a thorn in the heart of my Good? Oh what did I do! I cannot stand so much suffering!

Oh, my Love, let him be subjected to thousands of deaths but as a Christian! I said all these in a fit of weeping.

82 When I finished saying these last words, the weeping interrupted and I felt calm. || Again I said: My Love, yes, I promise you, if I have the fortune of seeing him die as a Christian I will not shed a tear, but I will absorb the sorrow given to me from your hands and I will be happy to hand him back to you so that he may be yours eternally. I cannot think otherwise about his soul, my God! How can you leave him to be lost, o Virgin of Sorrows? You have accepted to guard him as a child. Would you abandon him now? Oh, my Love, the soul!

What suffering for the soul of my son! The pain was increasing, my Good, I give you everything, save for me his soul!15

Terrible temptations, fear of becoming mad

So many great tribulations came upon me that I was not able to stand on my feet. Tossed in this way, I went to bed late at night, without any human comfort, alone. 83 I drowsed, halfasleep, then was shaken by an invisible hand; I opened my eyes and I saw that the opposite wall was totally open and it seemed to me as if it was falling; the || cracks were big. The fright I experienced only God could comprehend. I leapt from the bed, but I was unable to stand and I sat on the same; I wanted to run away, I was unable even to cry. There was a cloud of smoke in the whole room. For some time I stayed like that, then shaking I started to shout. The wall was closed: nobody came and I continued to cry. Alas, I was still sitting shaking when I saw big black beasts appearing on the same wall and they were running as wild beasts here and there. Oh, what they did! I calmed myself and said:

  • I have understood, you are the one, ugly monster who makes me feel much fear!

When they finished strolling much, they disappeared, but I was upset and trembling out of fear I had for the wall which by now was well united and nothing could be realized. Seeing the big walls of my room in Piacenza, I was not able to understand how it could happen. || 84 If I could have been asleep fine, but seated and with open eyes!

These beasts cause terrible unrest: I should become used to them. If they are small then I am serene and give them less consideration but if they are big … Woe betide me if I stay in the dark. What do they do? They lie on my hands. Oh, what a horrible thing! They are as cold as death, horrendous. They leave me with something horrible.

One night the lamp went off and one lie on my hand. Oh, what screams I made! It happened that they did not hear me;

it left me shivers so terrible that I was not able to calm myself.

I only said: “Who are you?” and they ran away.

One night they tried to shake the bed so strongly that I felt a strong oppression. A strong voice said to me:

  • You will become so crazy in a while, you will not bear it!

85 Aren’t you already? You are || losing your mind, what do you think? Finally, you can end it all; throw yourself out the window! Yes, you will do it!

Oh, what terrible pains! With the shaking of the bed and such oppression I fainted; I stayed holding my Crucifix tightly but he did not give me any comfort, as if he were hiding. Oh, where are you? Where is your sweetness? Is this how you leave me? Oh, my Love!

While saying this, oh, my side: how the ribs were rising!

Oh, sweet suffering that made me enjoy much and gave me the strength to sustain such cruel tortures of the enemy who torments me wildly.

My Good, in this way united with him, I was supplied with lights for his Work as to what I should do. Oh what sweetness is to die consumed of Love! But not! Suffering, labouring to please you, my dear Jesus!

86 On the eve of the Presentation to the temple, the temptations of becoming crazy were such that I was || fainting. I was writing and it made me make mistakes and with a loud voice it said:

  • You are mad; your head cannot hold it anymore.

I was unable even to formulate a word. I was in such unrest that I did not know how to go through and through;

though I struggled I did not succeed to calm myself. It was a worse, horrible temptation; when the enemy was putting sensible forms, humanly it is impossible to be able to resist.

Only my Good can put an end and raise me up binding with chains the ugly monster of hell. This is what my Good did; after suffering much, he comforted me.

Ineffable caresses and consolations

The next day, I experienced great things. Enraptured in him, he assured me that he would always be at my side and that nothing would happen to me. His caresses endured for the whole day, because I had always before me what I felt in the morning. || 87 Even at night, I always felt great things.

Oh, my Love, how I feel burning with the desire to make you known and loved by all! May your name be blessed in all languages, my God!

Oh, if I could only make everyone feel what I feel! Even exhausted, I feel an ardent hunger for suffering; I would be chopped to satisfy my blaze. This pig, oh, what I would do! And I would satisfy my burning thirst. Suffering, suffering, you are too sweet for me not to burn of the desire of possessing you!

In these days I saw various stars: one was small and indicated the death of a sister which is at hand.

Oh, my God, how many died! A crown appeared to me, but small. My God, you gave them and you take them back!

Oh, my Beloved, what a day of consolation! Twenty-two stars! My side, what I felt, have mercy on me; alas, || I cannot bear it anymore!

88 Last night, while I was serene in my God, I tried to sleep and think about nothing, wanting only to rest. But a strong shaking woke me; I opened my eyes and I saw a big beast with thorns as the hedgehog but thinner and it had certain legs as long nails. I was frightened because it seemed as if it wanted to throw me down from the bed and to scratch me. I took courage to ask who it was and soon it moved and went towards the ceiling. I asked:

  • Who are you?

Soon it fell down.

  • What are you coming for, ugly beast?

My God! 89 It upset me so much that I was not able to take rest. But immediately my Good came || to comfort me uniting me with him. I was absorbed in him and I regained peace and strength.

Preoccupation for her son Alessandro

I prayed for my son and I was telling him:

  • My Good, tell me, who will be beside his death bed? If it will happen who will give him the Crucifix? Who will make him confess? Oh, my Love!

While saying this, I was enraptured.

Oh, Being of my life, life of my life!
