FOUNDRESS OUT OF OBEDIENCE: FROM 1864 TO 1866

MS Booklet 2(3) – pp. 77- 187

In the same notebook where she wrote her memories on the history of the Institute until 1876, Mother Rosa felt an impulse to copy the notes she had kept on her daily meditation done in Genoa during Lent of the year 1864. This was the year in which, under the direction of Father Firpo, her spirit was fully open to the gift of contemplation while the love of the Crucified Spouse was leading her to do her best in the service of the poor sick and in various forms of apostolate. The discovery of God’s design in her was taking a profile. It was during that Lent on March 18, 1864 that her spiritual father wrote to her:

“It is not you anymore; you live no more; it is your Spouse Jesus, your love, your all who lives and acts in you…”1

From a confidence the Servant of God had with Sister Anne Celsa Speranza on December 1, 1883, we are informed that it was Father Firpo who ordered her to put her meditations into writing (cf. Chronology).

It can be said that these notes are the first writings of Mother Rosa that we have. She copied them with faithfulness and it is interesting to compare them with the pages written some years later: there is a clear evolution in the language, in the feelings and in the show of affection. The meditations are set out from the perspective of the future passion of the Saviour. And it is exactly this fruit, which in 78 the final addition it is hoped that the readers of this writing obtain. “To convert all those who will read it, to sanctify them with your divine love and make them lovers of your most holy Passion.”

We preferred to leave the text the way it is found in the autobiographic copy, without any subtitle.

In the midst of my papers I have found some written meditations – I really wanted to tear them - a strong impulse drove me to copy them as well as I could.

Accustomed to being led, when I feel that something blocks me and within me there is resistance, I follow the flow and I bother with nothing else.

1st Day of lent of the year 1864 in Genoa

After four days of fever and sufferings, suddenly recovered, || this morning in my mind I stayed in the desert, where my Beloved had gone for prayer. I begged him to allow me to remain near him. Oh, what a sweet union! The love I felt was such that I was consumed, by being so near to my Beloved. He prayed kneeling and I offered him my breast so that he may place upon it his blessed knees, not to feel the hardness of the stones. Oh, how I felt a bitter pain! Oh, my Love, your suffering is too much! I prayed that he may give such suffering to me and he would be || relieved. 79 My Good stood up. Speak to me, my Love, there is nothing that can give you comfort; surely, since it is late you would like to rest!

This is what happened: he leaned his head upon a stone. No, my Good, take your heart out of this chest of mine and let your head take a rest on it.

At this point, I was absorbed in him and the conversation lasted a long time. When I recovered, I found myself near my Good in the desert.

My sweet Love, I feel a strong torment within. 80 My Jesus why are you without anything to protect yourself from the severity of the weather? || I put this body under your feet as a stool, I have nothing else.

I remembered the penances: I took them all and I formed a tent; with the blood of the discipline I furnished the tent and I prayed my Good to accept it so that he may use it to protect himself from that mist which made him suffer much cold.

My Sovereign, the Master of heaven and earth, you want to suffer much for my love!

81 When I saw that the tent was not sufficient to protect the whole of the divine person || of my Saviour, turning to the Eternal Father, I asked him what I should do to make amends, and he imposed on me two things. I did the penance he told me to do. As I finished I was absorbed in my God and asked him to give me strength, and that he might always keep me with him on the mountain.

82 Recovered I prayed to the Blessed Virgin, that she may obtain for me to be consumed by love. ||

2nd Day

I was always with my God on the mountain. Oh, sweetest desert for me! My Good, having promised to remain with you I found myself in an extraordinary state.

Always with my Good and what sweet conversations!

I held his feet tightly and the union was such that in truth, I felt I would melt as I clasped them to my breast crying. Now it seemed to me as if 83 he asked for the salvation of sinners and I saw how very grieved he was. Oh, the || sorrow I felt! At the end I asked him to pour his grace upon my soul and moisten it, so that the flame of his divine love would grow. He appeared to me clearly in Holy

Communion. Oh, my sweet Love! Enraptured, I dwelt in him for long time, and was filled with sorrow when this moment came to an end. ||

84 3rd Day

I was always in flight to the desert. My Beloved was in prayer for sinners. I pleaded him to offer my whole being to the Eternal Father for the expiation of sins and to allow me to offer all his sufferings.

My God, how can I defend you from cold? Angels of heaven come down to warm the cold limbs of my Good! 85 Spread your wings and do not allow him || to suffer cruelly!

Again absorbed in God, I saw all his sufferings and I experienced sweetness. As I recovered I exclaimed: my Love, why do you not consume me? Everything that is earthly causes me repugnance! ||

86 4th Day

As I concentrated – this did not take effort, because what I saw and experienced in the desert remained impressed in my mind – I saw my Beloved praying to his Eternal Father. I was at his feet and I would have destroyed myself in tears if I could have obtained the gift. My breast was breaking, but I was unable to weep; I was like a stone.

My Love, so much || suffering! 87 Your feet cold and wounded with pricks caused by the stones! I looked for a way to soothe them. I have given you all: the renewal of my penances, this wounded body which I asked you to accept as a stool so that this uncultivated earth may not injure you more. Alas, it was I who reduced you to this cruel state. Again enraptured in him I spent hours. Love destroy me! ||

88 5th Day

Always in the desert, the thought that my Beloved was without food struck me. How much he will suffer! Yes, my

Love, as God you need nothing, but being clothed with human flesh, you will certainly suffer all the sufferings to which it is subjected.

Only the strength of God sustains you, since you are the son of God-God himself, divine.

89 Creatures, is not this enough for you to give up sin and || run to serve, adore and love the Lord? Five days have already passed in this horrid desert. Yes, your strength, which you communicate to me… and I stayed in the highest contemplation. I remained absorbed and it was also a conversation with my Beloved as if I was already really near my Saviour, at his feet. 90 I contemplated and I experienced much sweetness. My Love, everything is yours, I have nothing on my own. ||

6th Day

The thought that my Beloved on the horrid mountain was suffering from cold and that the rain wet him touched me and I grieved deeply. How can I amend so much suffering? Eternal Father, grant me to be a fire that can dry my Beloved.

How can I warm his limbs so numb with cold and water? 91 Eternal Father give me this suffering and relieve || my Good. Will you continue to stay on, my Love? 92 I will never be able to suffer with you, to satisfy the divine justice.

In this state, my Saviour, will you come down again to your dear Mother? And stopping at this point I wept. ||

7th Day

Today I remember little. I only feel happy because it seems to me I was with my Beloved. It was a union, I should say contemplation. He was praying and I was very close to him. 93 How much affection! I experienced a true yearning. I prayed and pleaded with the Eternal Father. I offered myself as a victim to relieve || my sweet Love from so much suffering. With him again, I find myself in him. It is sweet to suffer and it becomes a necessity, in order to follow in the footsteps of the Beloved. ||

94 8th Day

Oh, my Love, you are alive in this heart of yours, you pervade it all. How I grieve seeing you suffer so much for the ungratefulness of the human beings and most of all for my own ingratitude! Your feet are stained with blood because the hardness of the stones has broken your precious flesh. Oh, I want to collect your holy Blood so that no one treads upon it. 95 Your holy feet, which belong to || God in such a poor state!

In the suffering and weeping I felt my breast breaking. Eternal Father! I cried and prayed so long. ||

96 9th Day

Oh, my Father, grant me to suffer as much as my Beloved suffers. If my sins have reduced him to such a state, for this I want to obtain from you to suffer with him. Give me all his sufferings. I have no life, my life is Jesus, and he is the only one for me and in me.

97 May only his sufferings be my food. From now on, deprivations and anguish will be my food and I desire || nothing from this earth. His tribulations are my only consolation. ||

98 10th Day

Short of tears, I felt such an intense grief that my breast was breaking. I felt something that I was unable to understand but which bound me strongly.

Oh, my Love, I feel I have no more strength, grant me the gift of tears so that I may give vent to my sorrow. The thought that you are always on the mountain alone without any consolation is united with my suffering and I am not able to manage. 99 Let me listen at least || to your voice and see your face.

Let me die of love. After saying this, I had a feeling of intense union as if I were very close to him. I asked him to keep his right hand on my head,2 that he might direct me and lead me as it pleased him more. 100 I told him very many things. ||

11th Day

After a thousand words and affection which lasted a long time, I went on for meditation on the mountain. Oh, how much suffering for the ungrateful humanity! I started to consider and speak for those who offend me. I made fresh promises to do good for my neighbor, all that I could do with all my strength. Even in the midst of my cruel sufferings. || 101 I wanted to find a way to convert the poor sinner. Your love for the ungrateful humanity and your suffering for its salvation prompt me to make vows and steadfast promises to give my whole self for the poor sinner. With fresh promises and with a fire burning more than ever within me, I repeated, yes I will spend my 102 whole self for the sinner and if I will be able to save someone, I will bring her/him to your feet my Love. ||

12th Day

It is Saturday, a day dedicated to the Blessed Virgin

Mary. With my mind I went to the Mother and thought of the grief she experienced when she was deprived of her Beloved Son. With all the strength of my intellect I went to her and tried to speak to her.

  • Yes, I said to her: He is suffering in a horrid mountain.

103 But then I kept quiet because it || seemed to me, that the Blessed Virgin grieved. I experienced great suffering and by a flight with my mind I was with my dear Jesus on the mountain. Remaining there I asked him many things about the sorrows his Blessed Mother was suffering. My sweetest Beloved, what are these sufferings?

The Mother was suffering the afflictions of the Son and the Son was preparing his whole self to be consumed for the sake of human beings. ||

104 13th Day

Always in the desert and I felt his sufferings vividly. My Love, keep me under your feet and consume me with their fire; let me learn to walk well and to always pray, to meditate and contemplate in your presence. May the smallest of my actions be directed by your love. My Lord and my Master without your || guidance I cannot live, nor work well. 105 In this way, absorbed, I remained with my Good. ||

106 14th Day

I always felt with my mind set on my God on the mountain. Today I had such sorrow that I was not able to speak nor to consider anything. At a certain point I found myself united with my Good and I saw everything: his sufferings and beautiful, excellent lessons. Oh sweet union! 108 107 My soul has gained much knowledge and it was much strengthened || that as I returned to my work I felt no sorrow, nor the unpleasant smell of the sick. To attend these was sweet. In my God I was able to do everything.3 ||

15th Day

Oh, my Beloved, always in this desert, when will you come down? How come, your sufferings are seen clearly in your beautiful face. The thought that soon his delicate hands will be pierced caught me. No, my Love, this will never happen; the nails will pierce my hands but never yours. 110 109 I wept bitterly || until I was again absorbed. I remained in my

Saviour and I experienced much sweetness. ||

16th Day

Again, I had fresh in my mind the nail, which was to be hammered in his hand and I continued to weep.

I do not want these delicate hands to be pierced by steel, I repeated insistently. Oh, these delicate hands pierced by steel! Alas, my sweet Love, 111 I feel I cannot manage. I went into a deeper meditation. Your veins will be opened, your flesh will be || dragged by the nail to the cross. 112 Absorbed in this way I remained enraptured. I felt it deeply that my suffering pleased him. ||

17th Day

Continuing the contemplation on the sorrows he suffered, he seemed to me without strength. How can he sustain such suffering? And I wept bitterly.

113 Even me, I will remain in this desert, for I want to suffer all your sufferings. Whatever grief may weigh down upon me, I will never leave, || my Beloved.

I will only suffer and grieve with you, my Love.

114 18th Day

How unkind! Do you have the strength to nail these hands of paradise? No, I will hold you tightly, so they must pierce my chest before your hands.

I was fainting for the suffering was so great. I offered my sorrows for the sinners. I did all I could to torment this ass and I felt || an impulse to suffer. My thought ran to the thirst that my Beloved suffered in the desert, and I abstained from drinking for 15 days. 115 116 Later I drank a little and again I doubled my abstinence. My Love, how much you suffer!

19th Day

Throwing myself at his feet, I begged him to let me wet them with my tears. Since I had no other ointment to offer, like Magdalene I asked him to accept my grief and my tears. I held them tightly to my breast and moistened them with many tears. Oh, my Love, forgive me and give me your love that I may be consumed! || 117 In this way I stayed absorbed in my God. ||

118 20th Day

Tightly holding his feet, I suffered at the thought that they would soon be nailed to the cross and I wept. It seemed to me, I really saw his feet and the open veins pouring forth his precious blood; the flesh… Merciless torment, my God! || 119 Your heart already feels the nearness of such terrible torture. I stayed for a long time absorbed in this way. ||

120 21st Day

Always tightly holding his feet, every now and then, I said a word and then, weeping I remained there.

Give me these sufferings, my God. Give me your strength and then I will remain in sorrow with you. I will be crucified with you. Come down from this desert, the suffering is too much!

Oh, how to amend so much torment? After a while, || I remained for a long time in a sweet union. ||

22nd Day

As I entered into the meditation, with my mind I soon went to the desert. I did not find words but I felt deep sorrow, and in silence I stayed at his feet in sweet contemplation united with a heavy sorrow. Every now and then I cried: Sweet and sorrowful feet!

123 The meditation was very vivid and the || union ecstatic but, I was fully capable of feeling physically and of reasoning.4

I said: Your feet my Love, will endure martyrdom for the love of the ungrateful humanity. Give me all and be relieved, my sweet Love. 124 I looked at them and felt deep sorrow. ||

23rd Day

With my mind I placed myself at the feet of my Saviour and I grieved. I gazed up and my thought went to his breast.

I reflected on his sweet side. You will be fiercely pierced by a spear and what sorrow your dear Blessed Virgin

125 Mother will feel! I considered the torment and suffering, and with sorrowful tears gave vent || at his holy feet.

My Love, only God can bear up on this mountain:

solitary, inhabited by wild beasts which, though they do not approach you they bow down before you with reverence.

They are aware by instinct of being your creatures. It is only me unworthy creature who offends you! 126 With tears of deep sorrow I wept at his feet. ||

24th Day

With my mind in flight to the desert, and prostrate at his feet, I asked him to use me as his footstool so as to make amends in the best possible way for so much suffering. This day I had no words but a strong melancholy. The person of my Saviour was so alive in my mind that I could say I was very close to him. I looked at him and I wept and nothing else. ||

127 I said: My Love, you suffer for me; and I remained intimately united with my Good. I understood many things and most of all his love, which consumed me. ||

128 25th Day

My Love, open this breast of yours with the spear with which they will injure you. 129 Let it first pierce me, and in some way, I may be wounded by the same grief. Yes, my Love, with you to live and to die, may your sufferings be imprinted within me. Let nothing || trouble me, but that I may love your sufferings and suffer with you. ||

130 26th Day

Today is the first Friday of March, and I wanted to go to the desert at the feet of my God. But no matter how much I tried, I felt nothing. I was dry, and a crowd of nonsense thoughts carried me here and there. I then felt a strong pain for being the cause of many distractions and I suffered agonies. || 131 My Good, is it true that I did this?

I examined myself again but I could find nothing; I was unable even to weep. I truly had no feelings. Oh, I would have destroyed myself with beatings of discipline until bleeding, but nothing.

Don’t you want me with you anymore, my Love? An interior voice told me that he did not like my despair and that I am always with him. And there, at his feet, with new promises to do his will fully! ||

132 27th Day

Fully absorbed in my Good, I was reproached for grieving too vividly thinking I was the cause of such painful dryness.

A thousand pains my God, but you never hid yourself. I told him all my sorrows. 133 When I was at the point of telling him that I loved staying with him and I was embracing || his side, since this was considered the last day of his suffering, I was humiliated. 134 His sweetest reproach was enough to cover me with shame. ||

28th Day

I am always with my Good, and this day I am in an intimate union with him. I had a clearer understanding of his suffering. Every now and then I said a word: 135 give me your suffering and then I wept without being able to say a word. Always with him, only in him, || my whole life.

29th Day

136 Throwing myself at his feet, I wept thinking of the grave sufferings my Good was to bear. Then I stood up for I had a strong feeling that I was very much united with him and it seemed to me that I was very close to him. 137 Soon my thought ran to the crown of thorns. My Love, even your head will be pierced with thorns. They will be pushed mercilessly || into your veins and skull, which will kill you with pain. My grief was very strong and intense but I felt 138 it was not enough, because I kept repeating to him, give me the cruel crown, not you! ||

30th Day

Beautiful hair, after a few days it will be interwoven with the crown of thorns and will be snatched at with anger.

What a torment you will suffer! And many of these will be thrown to the ground and trod upon. I feel a profound grief, a true torment, my Love, because it is I who reduced you || to this heathen state. What did I do? At this point I stayed absorbed and what did I experience?

31st Day

I found myself as one who lives only on the sufferings of the Beloved. 139 140 I heaped on this donkey all kinds of penances that my poor mind suggested to me and I increased their number day after day. 141 Many were those suggested by my Love and many others I studied myself to oppress more this ugly pig. || I asked the Eternal Father if what I was doing pleased him. ||

142 32nd Day

Today I imagined him exhausted, again with infinite sufferings to endure.

My Love, how can those gentle shoulders sustain the enormous burden of the cross?No, no, my Eternal Father, give this to me. I must carry it alone, and not my Good!

143 I imagined how he would suffer with that burden and || I felt all the torment. Oh, how I see myself to be truly nothing and always so miserable. My God, address me a word, a look and tell me that I will always be yours, my Love! ||

144 33rd Day

I always felt close to my Good on the mountain of suffering, I wept and meditated on every kind of suffering he was to bear. I grieved, but unexpectedly a devouring fire came within me and it consumed me. There were moments in which it seemed to me that I could be destroyed by that devouring fire. || 145 I felt immense joy, and yet I was in terrible agony, and with pleasure I felt a great and consoling contentment at the feeling that I was being destroyed, and I would never have wanted it to stop. 146 Oh, how sweet it is to die for love! ||

34th Day

I was always in the desert, together with my Good I did penance and fasted. But I was not able to fast as completely as he did for 47 days!

I did penance to expiate all the greediness that all human beings and I myself commit and to satisfy divine justice so that the Lord may lead us to the sweet path of the new commandment and free us from the terrible torment of slavery.5 || Oh, Love, what is your reward? You already had a foreboding, and you experience truly cruel suffering.

147 How can I lament the ingratitude of creatures while I did worse things towards my God? ||

35th Day

I was always with my Good, and today I remained absorbed in him and received graces and great knowledge of the soul with God, his center and portion.

149 148 I almost neither feel pain nor could I think of anything else, while in this union nothing can occupy our faculties.

All our powers concentrate on God and on his absolute divinity. || the soul remains completely absorbed in its

Being. ||

36th Day

Today, I felt intensely all his sufferings and I told him many things. My Good, I feel my breast breaking for your suffering, I feel I have no strength. Staggering and again embracing his holy feet, I went on to contemplate his hands and then his breast and his head and I destroyed myself in tears. Come down form this mountain, your suffering is destroying me; I cannot bear to see you in such a state. ||

Unfortunately, the worst is to come, the suffering in the 150 151 courts of Caiaphas and Pilate and the proximity of the torturers. Your beautiful face will receive blows and your fair hair will become reddish with Blood.

37th Day

Your flesh my God will be badly scratched by the thorns; let me restore you: put me before the lashes so that you may be safe. But I hear a voice telling me:

152 He must be the only victim.

Is it not possible to amend so much cruel torture and the || fierce lashes? At least, let me collect your precious Blood along the way. Oh, Love, for me only the suffering. ||

153 38th Day

I always felt close to my Good in the desert. In my mind, the memory of his passion was represented step by step. Now I kept looking at his feet as he walked on the stairs. Those with spears will beat him and he will shed Blood from the blows he will receive. The scoundrels will mistreat || his gentle limbs.

154 My Love, what a torment! I want to throw myself to the ground and beg you to step upon this body with your gentle feet. ||

155 39th Day

What a great torment your heart will experience! It forebodes everything and feels intense sorrow. How can I find a way to relieve you from such fierce torment? How I feel a strong desire for suffering. Look at me! The whole of this body is covered with iron points and every day I increase the beatings. 156 When I think that || from your breast Blood will pour, a strong desire of pouring blood from my veins holds me, and seeing it gives me much consolation. If pieces of flesh come out, I feel happy thinking that even your breast will be treated in the same way. My Love, your scourging!

157 I studied how to tie myself by the pillar, but not having one, || I used a big log and I dragged myself as I could; but since I was alone, in comparison to the sufferings of my Love, it is nothing.

158 I narrated to my Good in the desert: I would certainly be happy if you could send an angel to beat this miserable body of mine. || I try to tie myself as well as I can to the big log, in the shape of a cross. 159 Oh, my Love, it is sweet to suffer for you, my God. ||

40th Day

Today, alone in him, the contemplation took a short time.

I was able to meditate much and to know that my penances pleased him. 160 I always studied new penances and I tried to offer them to my Good, that he may accept them for the conversion of poor sinners. || He made himself a victim for love. 161 Oh, my Love, how can I describe my pleasure in suffering? It is impossible! I had great pleasure. ||

41st Day

Unexpectedly the thought of the crown of thorns took me. 162 I stopped to meditate: on your fair hair of paradise, which will be interwoven with a fierce crown of sharp thorns, Blood from the wounds – because of the sharp thorns – will pour upon your breast. || Oh, my Love; I will also wound my head, not with thorns but with steel!

This is what I did with a crown of steel with points. I pressed it on my head until blood came out so that I could say to my Good: here is my head which caused you much suffering. It is wounded and pours blood! ||

163 42nd Day

On the mountain I showed him my wounds and I told him what I deserved. But you, my Love, no, you want to suffer for me, my dear Good! I showed him the crown which caused him much pain. I delighted much in suffering and for me it was a real consolation.

164 How is it || my Love? I see that, every now and then I am unable to bear for lack of strength. Could this be an action of the devil?

No – he answered – all is my grace, even the relish you feel in suffering.

Oh, my sweet Love, the desire to scourge this miserable body intensified always more. No part of my body was without pain. ||

165 43rd Day

My Love, in comparison to the sufferings you will bear, what I try to do to injure this body is very little. The thought grasped me that my Good will be given gall to drink and that his lips will be wet with gall and vinegar. What did I do? 166 I tried to take unpleasant stuff to embitter || my taste. I also had dry lips out of thirst, depriving myself of drinking. I wet them with bitter vinegar in order to feel the suffering of my Good. Oh, what pleasure I felt!

44th Day

167 My Love, always in this desert, exhausted from much suffering. Tell me, my Love, have I tried to follow you in your suffering? 168 Tell me, my Love, I was able to do all I could to follow you in your sufferings, but I am not able to nail my hands and my feet. Send for me an angel who will crucify me on the cross. ||

I begged him. However, I did not receive any reply. I grieved and I wept much. Always with my mind I tried to think how I could but I was unable and I wept bitterly.

169 Oh, my Love you will be cruelly nailed and me? ||

45th Day

What do you think, my dear Saviour? Finally, I hope, you will come down from this desert. Your gloom makes me understand everything. Oh, holy wood, most pure and passionate love, which made you die on this wood. I feel torn, yet I want || to live and to die on this wood. But I will never be nailed if you will not send executioners to crucify me; grant this to me! I cannot nail my hand on the cross!

My Love, I love the cross and upon it I want to be crucified.

Yes, I hope and await this from you!6 ||

46th Day

Always close to my Good in the desert, I gazed at him.

My mind meditated on the holy passion and I tried to discover all his sufferings. Thinking of the cruel torture he will go through I said: my Love, your delicate shoulders will carry a heavy wood which will scratch the skin and Blood will pour; 172 the flesh || will come out as you drag the dry wood. How can I make amend? What can I do, my Good?

You see everything clearly before you and feel much pain.

Oh, what a torture, my Love! I am so miserable that I am not able to amend, because you suffer for me. I would like to give you a sure proof that I want to suffer with you.

173 I then tried to offer one by one my pains, || the penances which I always try to increase until I can’t bear; I still desire, if I can, to subject this humanity to further penances, but the fear stops me because I could already see it myself to be unable to bear it through anymore. ||

174 47th Day

Finally, today you will come down from this heathen desert and you will return to your Mother. What a joy and a grief, since you will remain with her for only a while. My

Love, do you also want to submit yourself to the temptations? This is the last suffering to which you want to submit your humanity, although you cannot be tempted nor have a tempter. || 175 Nevertheless, you let the ignorant, blind, proud devil think and have the courage to come and test your person. May it be confused and put to shame, disheartened and in its pride disgraced. 176 Conceited it comes to test its creator; it undertakes the task and tempts you with food, while with only one act you || destroy its power; confused and brutalized it returns to its abyss. My Love, do you want to bear even this suffering? This is to teach me, that in the battle I should put my trust in you and the victory will be mine; that is not enough. My Love, your beautiful mouth of paradise will be rudely injured by filthy spittle; || what a disgust your stomach will suffer! 177 Oh, when I think of this I consider all my delicacy in eating, that I feel repugnance for everything while you received nasty spittle for me.

Oh, what humiliation to consider a God so cruelly injured… and 178 all to teach me to give up once and for all so much delicacy and to seek only || to please you my Good, mortifying myself especially in these delicacies. But it is not yet enough; when you will be on the cross, cruelly fixed horror! You know well, your lips will be wet with gall and vinegar and this comfort will be given you with a sponge.

179 You will be thirsty for the fire of love that consumes you but || they will badly give you vinegar. Oh, my Love! Where and how can such cruel suffering of yours and of your sorrowful mother be amended? Whatever those who are at their last breath and those condemned for their wickedness ask for, they are given; only my God who is the Master and the creator of all did not receive.

180 Oh, how || I go on considering my enormous delicacies in food, careful not to have anything that could embitter my foul taste!

181 I see clearly how I fall short, because I do not search in all kinds of food to have something that could bring disgust and avoid || tasteful food. I want to take no drink without mixing it with ashes, even if it is dirty. I will also mix it with the food which I will be given to eat. 182 Before I was putting it in one dish or in soup, my Love, now I will put it everywhere. I will try || to have for food whatever is disgusting and I will always think of you, my Love.

The union I felt was such that I always seemed to be close to him such that I remained absorbed. Oh, how my Beloved was sweet for me!

183 How happy I could have been if I had never || come back to live in this miserable earth! I do not know why I was overcome by the thought of copying this mess. Now that I reached the end I feel regret and I am tempted much to burn everything. But my voice keeps me back, telling me not to do it. 184 Oh, certainly if it does not please you, || my Love, let it remain and I would do more, but the thought that I could harm your souls… you know I could not do it.

185 Therefore I wish to give to you this writing, to change these scribbles in many heavenly sayings to convert all those who will read them; sanctify them with your divine love and make them lovers of your most holy Passion that they may have it present always day || and night.

I hope for everything out of your mercy. May whatever imperfection I have committed be by your infinite mercy forgiven and you my Love will hold me tightly to you without any merit.

|| Your Passion assures me in everything. Oh, what shall

186 I say of the day of resurrection? What feelings I had! I stayed all the time beside the tomb and did not seek food or try to pray. I called him and wanted to be with him in the closed sepulcher. 187 Like Mary Magdalene, I sought him,

Risen, and when I found him, oh, my Love! || Who can describe what I went through and what I had from you? I shall say that it was a continuous rapture to be in constant dialogue with my God, receiving very beautiful lessons and knowledge. Oh, love only my God, you creatures who seek good! Everything is in him, outside him all is mud. SECTION II
