INTIMATE NOTES OF EVERY YEAR

Intimate notes year per year - 1872

MS 3 - pp.1-83

MS 4.1 – pp. 1-8

The spiritual notes, started with certain regularity in 1871, became more frequent. Mother Rosa felt the need of enriching her intimacy with the supreme Good, of giving shape on the paper to whatever she experienced within her; she also needed to find an intimate compensation for the afflictions aroused by the world. The year 1872 was a difficult year because of the troubles of the Rule of the Institute, whose expansion is moreover the best argument in favor of the divine support.

The Rule written by Father Tornatore not only was rejected by the Congregation of the Bishops and Regulars but was handed over to the Holy Office. On 17 February 1872, the Holy Office gave an order to withdraw from circulation and to destroy all the printed copies of that text. The co-founder was dismissed immediately from service to the Daughters of St. Anne. At the end of February 1872 Mother Rosa went to Rome to negotiate personally with the Cardinal Prefect and she had an audience with Pius IX on 4 March. According to the direction of the same Congregation, she herself was to write the text of the Constitutions under the guidance of Bishop of Ferrara Monsignor Luigi Giordani. She finished the writing on 26 April and submitted it to the revision of Cardinal Vannicelli. On June 18 the Rule was sent to the Sacred Congregation.

This second writing was also rejected in Rome; everything was to be changed. This was communicated to her in early December 1872 assigning to her, the Jesuit, Father Fava as a consultant. But the whole of 1873 and half of 1874 would pass before the Daughters of St. Anne could have their own Constitutions approved ad experimentum. She struggled for more than three years striving to obey the words of Pius IX: “Keep firm the spirit.”

Intervals of light and loving sweetness in the intimacy with her Beloved accompanied with repercussions in the heart wounded with love were not missing. But there was predominance of bitter purifications: profound 1 afflictions without relief with faith as the only guide, abandonments by God, duplicity and pretence in the Church personages, humiliations… Worse when her spirit was at the mercy of temptations and suggestions of the devil, with incitement to despair and even with fears of being condemned, thrown away from God for ever…

MS 3 - pp. 1-83

Instructions and “illustrations” of Jesus. St. Anne appears cheerful

Date 13 March 1872: I thought I would die for the fire that burned me. The union with my God was such that I had to distract myself so that they might not realize.

My Jesus gave me many instructions, especially by explaining to me very clearly my actual situation: the numberless pains that I suffer, why he allows them, the death of various people who apparently seemed incomprehensible to me. 2 But he who governs and acts in this Work of his, he well knows how he removes or gives as it pleases him. I was very calm and dealt with everything in peace. The mental illustrations became much clearer and alive, with surprise I heard sublime words coming out of my mouth, and I found everything easy: preaching, doing and undoing anything that could be requested of me, if it regards faith or || conscience; today I had all these.

There were some days in which I realized that I was moving out of that state of spiritual discouragement when I was not aware of acting and I was very confused in acting. I spoke, but I did not know whether I did well or bad. I was dry, arid; all the senses had become dormant. Every now and then small and big stars appeared to me, a sign that a soul was leaving the earth – this happens when someone I know or a little girl in one of the houses 3 dies – I am not able to explain why every now and then a white cross a bit big appears to me. This appears to me many days before that person dies. It makes me sad || when a black one appears to me I pray but coldly. I presume some thing badly, but my God had not yet clearly showed me anything.

There are two days now that I see the Holy Mother very cheerful. This morning she was laughing and she spoke to me interiorly while I asked her to grant me grace to see her Rule approved soon. After I prayed to her for providence, she said that I would have the one and the other, which is everything. She added that time will come in which I will have great reward for the pains I suffer. 4 I am very sure of this. It seems to me, I have already everything. In fact yesterday I had the beginning of what she assured me will happen: I will return to be guided by the one she calls my Son.1 ||

Holy Week. Afflictions and temptations

I had two days of hell: alone, wherever I turned my eyes

I found the sharpest thorns. Heaven was closed; there was an abyss open for me.

In the Work of God, the cruelest afflictions fell down upon my head. My life was a continuous spasm from holy

Tuesday until this morning, that is holy Saturday, when in the middle of the meditation I felt something pleasant coming upon me and it seemed to me it took away all the restlessness which surrounded me as a big cloud. This year

I desire to stay on my feet, so that nobody could say: “The

Mother is already sick.” How much pain they caused me!

And I prayed much that everything may remain hidden; I obtained it but the martyrdom was worse.

5 It could be said that I was feeling equally the || sufferings, but he gave me the strength to remain always on my feet. However, the temptations, the isolation, the lack of the least comfort that I felt was horrible. I could not even have a moment to say: My God, what pains are these for the expiation of my sins! Nothing!

I was feeling assailed by a dominating spirit; it did not allow me to have the least comfort. I had bitterness from all sides. Providence was very far; at the end there was nothing for me. My suffering was so much that one evening I was despairing. I wanted to collect my mind to see which decision I should take; emptiness was taking over in my mind to such a point that I was able to think of nothing. I was not able to think of anything. 6 In the evening || the evil spirit wanted to drown me and after much more noise in my room it tried to strangle me, but it never touched me physically.

The agony and the strangling were such that there were some moments in which I felt there was a tightening on the throat which went up to the head and seemed to me to sink, that is, to drown.

I had many thoughts and I said to myself:

  • Look, these are diabolic bearings. I am therefore damned, I have failed. What did I do! I did not understand well your words, my God!

I said this, when I was able; and it was very rare. Therefore, this morning I could write more consoled and resigned to everything and in peace || I looked at my risen Jesus. 7 While I was going to receive Holy Communion, in that church I found a picture of St. Anne, our Mother. How she comforted me! She assured me that she could have cared for her daughters; she also promised me the return and the confirmation of her Son, that is how she called him.

Everything will change in favor of the Work

Now I am calmer than ever. He showed me that I still have to undergo many battles but his Work will overcome everything and will be victorious if he gives me the strength to resist. After the Eternal Father and my Spouse Jesus gave me many caresses, I felt fortified. 8 The person who disgusted me and wildly slandered me will repent and return to be more disposed in this Work than before || I see only the grace that God gives me so abundantly and while I receive sad insults and bad injuries I do not feel even the least grudge towards those who offended me, moreover I feel a rapture … I desire nothing else if not benefiting them.

I did not speak of the usual gloom that I feel on Thursdays: alas, this is indescribable!

In the moment in which he clarified to me many things, there was also a reason for which the good souls are kept in the dark and he does not want miracles, though he said they can perform whatever they want. 9 This was clear for he gave me an explanation. Soon those good days will return || in which the good will have faith, because even they unfortunately have failed. They are good superficially but not truly Christians who believe all with an alive faith; now they let it extinguish. Everything is materialism even in the good. They do not realize it but it dominates them for their punishment.

“My governing Spirit.” Fire of love

I cannot say it but I feel that I am being strengthened by my governing Spirit. What a consolation this is for me when

I am abandoned by every human help, to have my dear spirit that guides me and supports me in everything even in very painful days! He works and carries everything excellently. 10 As for myself I feel only misery, shame and || confusion.

Today is Easter. This morning my Beloved led me into his dwellings; he made me taste his sweetness but the delight was very brief. I soon returned in the midst of the misery of a painful life, the way I find myself now. But today the fire was consuming me and I was obliged to bathe though it did not help me much. Today I lived peacefully, I mean that peace of spirit; there was calm for the whole day in the midst of the pains of this life.

“Jesus speaks for me, acts for me and directs me in everything”

I received a graceful reproach while I wanted to make a grimace about something which was presented to me. I heard a sweet voice:

  • Rosa what are you doing? Do you still have a great deal of courage?

Alas, what I felt! I soon stopped and prepared myself to take what was repugnant to me. || 11 My God gave me much strength not to utter a word. In this way nobody noticed. I wish to confess that many times it happens that I am thoughtful in almost everything. When I speak I do not speak well because my mind is occupied elsewhere.

Alone as I am in this great Work - I am saying the truth - I am not lost as before. To think that I have no one and am without direction; yet it does not trouble me, because each problem is solved one by one by my Jesus. He speaks, works and directs me in everything. I can feel and with even greater clarity I can see that I am guided by my Spirit.

For some time my cloud has been far from me. I see it far away, it tells me nothing; it seems it has left me in the dark. || 12 When it was close I asked and it answered everything, it was enough just looking at it. Inside there I understood everything.

Now not anymore, my disgracefulness had reduced me this way.

Great affliction because of the text of the Rule

This evening I have – at least it seemed to me – clear in my mind what I felt as I received the fatal blow, that of burning the Rule, that could have destroyed the Work of my God. It cannot be described! I had great tension in this beast of body; the nerves twisted, my poor intellect was struck dumb, it was unable to think, to discern; my breast a bronze, the eyes dry as if the vein of tears were closed. 13 I remained like this the whole night, and in the morning after

Holy Communion I was not able || even to say: my God, where are you?2

After suffering for some time, my nerves were upset and the breast as if a vein was opened. I wept a flood of tears, but I have to confess that I understood nothing. I acted but I do not know why and how I acted. I did everything, not me but the one who lives in me. I was answering but I do not know what; everything went in order but I did not know who ordered.

In truth I was not able to collect anything in my poor mind. 14 It seemed to me as if I had a tight crown on my head.

Nothing, nothing could I say to myself: I will do this, I will think about the other thing. I was directing but I understood nothing. || The Being who is in me did everything.

Today I felt great things. At first I was gloomy and it consumed me. It seemed to me as if ahead of me there was an abyss of sadness.

I had to struggle much not to let others realize it.

As I reached the edge of despair, my cloud appeared to me and it supplied me with strength and faith. My spirit was quite calm as someone awaiting something new from afar. I started to think, my mind darkened, I had unrest upon me that seemed to me as if I were stricken by the sea waves in the tempest. I was unable to hold on to my thought. The Work of God had fallen into the most || obscure mud.

15 I felt abandoned from all sides; the persecutions were my only companions. I turned to pray the Holy Mother but I saw her with a corpse-like face and since it was the first time I saw her like this it frightened me.

  • Who will die, my Mother?

She did not reply.

  • What do you have? Perhaps your Institute is agonizing? Oh, for pity’s sake, take away from me this affliction; I cannot stand the thought.

Alas, what can I do? Saying this and trying to question my Being I was enraptured in him and everything was diminished, but returning to the affairs of the Work I felt it again: my God I have no more life, I feel like dying an agonizing death! Why should I always suffer? 16 Stopping || I said to him: suffering with you, dying with you!

I did not know where to turn; I had been the whole night on the table writing. At three I lay down from weariness and I started the rosary. As I finished, I was still unable to sleep. Finally after a spiritual communion I dozed but soon something woke me up.

Since I was turned towards the wall opening my eyes I saw a big beast. I was frightened and while I was waking up it ran on the two sides of the wall but it disappeared soon. When I woke up I realized that it had the same shape as those which were appearing in my poor cell some months ago.

17 This one was small, black with the usual clutches || around the whole body. It was very similar to the spiders, but bigger, black and round.

I stayed awake for long time. Finally the hour of meditation arrived; I did it with much union and I had some comfort. But could I ever receive anything if my infamies have reduced me so badly!

Light on the splendid future of the Work

In the distance I see many great things for our Institute. A light let me see the great panorama of the Order in the future. I will say that the divine ordinance was so beautiful and interwoven that I remained ecstatic and overjoyed, while in it I also saw a river of numerous sufferings. 18 I was not frightened by this vision, it seemed to me that I could undergo || much more. I returned peacefully in myself and as I thought I felt stricken with horror. How will my destroyed corpse stand? How will it bear the weight? I am so weak and my poor mind so wearied, will it stand? On the other hand I think and I say to myself:

  • Haven’t you seen what will happen to you at the end of all this? You will have peace and calm and you will die happily in the Lord. Why do you doubt?

19 I felt fortified with such reflections but when for a moment I withdraw my mind, I am overtaken by fear. || I do not know, but from this morning a star first red, now clear, smaller than usual is moving around me. Alas, who could this soul be? I feel sorrow.

“I abandon myself on the pillow of faith: I know and I see nothing”

The pain I suffered these days was too much. I carry an acute pain that there are some moments in which if I did not control myself tears could flow from my eyes.

I went to the church to weep at the feet of my God. Not even there did I find peace, but I was able to give vent to my suffering. Yes, my God, my agony is of the most atrocious death. What pains! You are crueler than death!

On all sides there were agonizing pains, all the roads are blocked for me. I only see a big precipice that drags me to itself: it is despair.

20 Its force of attraction || is such that if it was not for the divine power that sustains me I could not resist falling.

Terrible day that has knocked me down and, I cannot see any reason; only a wall stands before me, the only one which holds me back from falling down was that which brought me a flash of reflection, to be able to say to the one who holds me back from falling: God the Being who lives for me.

Then without thinking of anything I abandon myself on the pillow of faith, not being able to see the one who sustains me, the Being of my life. 21 I know nothing, I see nothing; I know not where I am, what I do, and for whom I do it. It is he who || can give me life3.

Today, or rather this morning, after Holy Communion, I had a great deal of concentration that held me tightly in perfect union with my God. I remained so convinced of my nothingness and what I suffer is so little in comparison of the infamies that I have committed that seemed me I had no more courage to be in the presence of God. With both hands I covered my face telling to my Jesus: I feel ashamed!

Peace and resignation, love with adversaries

Meanwhile I was with him, the union became more intimate and I discovered my nothingness even more strongly. In all this my pains remained an abhorrence of myself.

22 Ah – I exclaimed – how good you are, my Eternal Father! How many times I dared ask you, || bother you as if I had some claims! The agonies, the injuries were painful in some moments – on the back – not to find refuge in you. Coming to search for you and in making my complaint to you, it seemed to me I could find enough help to face many sufferings, which could diminish only by your help, but I did not find you, my All; that was the cause of feeling much pain.

Today it was not like that because everything seemed nothing in comparison of much disgracefulness. What humiliation, what confusion! 23 When I was able to say a word: my God || have pity on me! Have compassion on this helpless creature. I know I merit nothing, but have pity! My ugliness is too much and that is why your Institute suffers. Alas, what a dread!

The fire burned me; there was something on my left side, something was moving inside and this sweet movement whenever it comes it makes me die. What are you doing, my Jesus? Move aside for I am dying! Have pity, let no one realize; do with me what you like provided no human creature realizes it.

24 I do not understand how human beings hate those who offend them; sometimes I pause to think what they feel, what this aversion is and from where it originates. Yes, from the slanders they receive, but how || could they feel angry?

The more I think of it the less it satisfies me. It is true that when afflicted one can say a word to relieve one’s feelings but then going down to the intimacy of ourselves we find that there is always an equal affection like before when we loved each other.

I believe it is like this in everything. I do not say to whom I feel a debt of gratitude. I am saying the truth, the way one feels is very different. I would like to offer myself for them ready for any sacrifice. I feel peace and resignation that is extraordinary. 25 Even today I was assured about providence, that it will come and I will see great things; in this way all the Daughters of St. Anne, || Mother of Mary

Immaculate will be spared any kind of punishment.

The manner of offering the penances to God

Last night after much suffering, as I ended the agonies that I felt because of the headache, a beautiful red heart, blossoming with radiant sparks stayed before my eyes for three minutes. As I saw it, I was in ecstasy and when it disappeared it left me so inebriated that I spent the rest of the night in a perfect union with God; the fire was so burning that it consumed me.

Tomorrow, feast of the Holy Cross4, I already feel the effects, my beloved. In my miserable life you have always been my companion. || You will certainly be the bed of my final rest.

26 The Being who lives for me, on 10 May 1872, made me understand how I should offer my penances.

I was grateful to see how he had arranged things: the fasting for the conversion of sinners, eating herbs for the providence of the Institute, the chains which I have carried for many years so that tightly chained to his heart, I may be consumed by his love, the wounds caused by the continuous carrying of the chains to be helped to reach soon that perfect union with him, my eternal All.

Some days ago that ugly beast which runs on the ceiling of my room came to torment me but at a certain moment it disappeared.

27 In these days || the right side is very swollen and I feel very sick; in the same way in some moments I feel more pain on the hands and feet.

“My poor soul is alone, isolated in the midst of the great world”

The grace of not remaining enraptured after receiving the absolution continues. Only God knows how much I have to struggle to take my mind off it! Ah, what a painful state I am in! My poor soul is alone, isolated in the midst of the great world orphaned, and when it is desolate, drowning in bitter tribulations, as those arid tumultuous days, a turbulent murmuring rules it. Now it finds itself in the despair of the damned. It has lost its Being and can find him nowhere. 28 Yes, my God, I go to your tabernacle and remain dumbfounded. A single word || cannot come out of my mouth. Wherever I look I see only a precipice; I look at my deeds, to see if I can find any comfort in them, thinking that in my All I will have a support. Though I try to look in to them, I find I am completely deprived, I see nothing that is mine: everything is dispelled at the appearance of my nothingness.

What sufferings are these? I do not speak of the fear that causes this state in me: I can only say these are the fires of hell.

I have lost my Beloved, the only object of my existence!

Alas, many times I would throw myself to the ground having terminated receiving him and I would destroy myself by beating. 29 Anguish, a thousand fears, temptations of despair are all || around to suffocate me.

The long sleepless nights torment me. Once they were of comfort: I could say they were a sweet rest for me while I remained most of the night kneeling. Now lying face down stretched out on the ground, the forehead resting on the floor, the arms extended in the sign of the cross, I pray until

I am tired. Standing I find myself downcast and completely empty of any good feeling. What pains! I am alone, without my Beloved for he has abandoned me.5

Presage on the plague threatening Europe

Yesterday, 17 May 1872, while I was lying it seemed that

I was already sleeping, when a voice woke me. It shook me saying:

  • Look!

30 I was struggling to open my || eyes and I suffered because I would have liked to take that little sleep that I rarely had time for. But the strength was so much that I woke up. I opened my eyes and on the wall I saw a big black stain which spread throughout the room. From that point black babbles came out as if the plague was coming out of the wall, similar to the babbles of black smallpox and it spread on the ceiling. I asked:

  • What does this mean?

  • The plague that will come soon. The black stain is Paris and after it will spread all over the world.

I asked:

  • Will the Daughters of St. Anne Mother of the Immaculate be safe?

Today I received beautiful lights regarding the person with whom I had to speak concerning the Rule. 31 Twice I read deep into his heart but he was not very satisfied || with my answers.

After everything vanished a voice was added to that which woke me. The sight of the stained wall stayed for eight minutes. It said only:

  • Remember!

It was true. When the Eternal Father blessed the oil he said that it will be used for the plague. My God, what fear! Only the thought that it will come as it was designed on the wall. What a slaughter will occur?6

In defense of the title of the Institute

A murmuring spirit tormented me much, especially whenever there were battles to be endured in the Institute, such as over the Rule. This ugly monster tormented me very much.

  • Give up everything. Look: you are not able to come out!

32 What a temptation, and then many more || shrewd temptations, that take me to despair. How much it hates this work! How much it tried to knock to the ground the Work and me!

Really, in this ignorance is seen because it is stupid to be against God. It is ignorant. How much I would be comforted if I could explain what I felt when I was threatened that the name of St. Anne Mother of Mary

Immaculate would be removed! What a wound I received!

All the muscle-fibers stretched, the nerves twisted, the head was all upset that I lost the memory of what I had to say.

33 All seemed || lost, I could not take care of these concerns.

In one word all seemed useless to me because it would not exist; in fact I was no longer attracted by courage.

I did not have anymore desire for prayer. I did not know what to say when I was in the presence of the living God nor when I heard the sorrowful words regarding the removal of my mother whom I love much. Oh, it is because the person who does not love an object cannot understand the suffering this could cause to the person who loves. Someone who had never had a mother because God took her while the person was a child cannot understand the affection of the child for the mother.

This is how they want to take away my Mother, and I live in her house without her. 34 No, no, a thousand deaths but I have to save the Mother! In this sorrowful || event my suffering was so much that I was not able to say a word either to God or to the Holy Mother. I looked at them dumb, only the pain spoke to the soul. Alas, pain! It is too much my God;

I cannot bear it, sustain me!7

I threw myself down with my face to the ground. I can say nothing to my Eternal Father but only: 35 have pity on me; my God I cannot bear it! Then I remained as unconscious with my face to the ground and did not know what to say. There was nothing that could bring back reason. I felt the mind flaring up as if wounded, throwing itself here and there as someone thoughtful searching for something. It does not know what it thinks; it wants to reason but does not know || how to bring the correct thoughts, because it feels a great confusion in her mind. What pains one suffers!

When I tried to stay a bit for prayer, I became mute and many times I was not able to say the Our Father. I do not remember having started it and I do not remember having said it, or if I reached half way or I had to start over. My memory disappeared and I was not right anymore. Pity, my God! What days of hell! I feel the world, the persecutions and all the rest strangling me! Patience! My God, send me everything but do not let me materially go crazy, because I cannot love you anymore. For everything I … || Alas, only thinking of it I feel like fainting! No, my God!

36 Setbacks and sufferings in the revision of the Constitutions

I do not know how to express myself regarding our Constitutions!

Having concluded speaking with a religious, assigned for the revision of the Constitutions, I felt something tightening my mind as if I was under pressure. I was feeling an aversion towards that religious that every word he said was an enormous load on me. When he went away a space or rather an empty space was created in my mind. 37 The intellect was not able to reason on the minimum matter of the Constitutions. I tried to gather my ideas forcing myself to reason and carry out what I was asked to do; I was not || able. My head was breaking and I was taken by an abyss of a thousand other very different thoughts not belonging to the Work. My God! I ran to his feet crying: Oh, my Jesus, have pity on me! Have compassion on me!

In this way I remained in deep pain absorbed in my loving Being and enraptured in a deep sleep, leaning on his side, without saying or feeling anything. It only seemed to me that it came down as a balm to heal me, with right and peaceful thoughts; little by little I gained peace and reasoning.

As I came to my senses, I said to my Good:

  • Why did it happen like that? I could have submitted myself to the wishes of these good religious, and I should not have opposed them. 38 Why could I not bear the religious who spoke to me? Alas, it might be || diabolic work!

  • No, - a very gentle interior voice said to me – I do not want the rule to be written by this religious. Those of my Son will be approved.8

I did not know which expedient to take and I kept quiet;

what should I do? Thinking within myself, without hearing anything, I felt this way:

  • I will leave everything, and when you wish, my God, you will make them approved. I am very miserable, capable of doing nothing, but of spoiling your Work.

Having said this, a peace, and calm took over in me… I only felt melancholy but sweet and consoling. Patience!

Peace reigned in me. Oh, yes, you are my spirit because you gave me peace and now I feel like living.

39 He gave me a thousand || other understandings particularly on the desire I had regarding the quick approval of the Rule not to have anguish when I present myself in a new diocese.

Even this doubt was loosened very well: When the Institute will possess many houses it will not face many objections. In this way a large number of religious will give a firm stability to the institute itself.

All these clear ideas that my poor intellect was forming calmed my unrest and a peace, strength and resignation … were taking over in me.

I was calm, having placed in God alone everything || without having the least thought that could disturb me. 40 Peace and resignation are growing in me every day in an extraordinary way. I see with my eyes that it is all God’s work; there was nothing which could upset my thinking that my Being, author of everything, will look favorably on his Work. In the midst of much pain I enjoy peace and resignation that keep me so tightly united to my All, God, that every thing seems to me small. Only one thing disheartened me: it is my uselessness and seeing myself at all moments less than nothing. The sight of my weaknesses and of my littleness disheartens me and I am always fearful in acting. I always turn to my Jesus, my wisdom. 41 Oh, for pity’s sake you act, speak, work; do not humiliate me more by leaving me even for a minute. Alas, || certainly I should not see the Work humiliated, even if it will be seen badly. What confusion mixed with a continuous fear!

Vision of the souls in Paradise

Yesterday, a day of the Body of the Lord, I was in the church in adoration. While I was in this way I was absorbed in God and my spirit was enlightened. Suddenly Jesus said to me:

  • Look!

I seemed to see all the souls who are in Paradise.

  • These are those who received me. While they were alive they were fed with my body.

These souls were covered by a very bright light and it was not easy to see them. The quantity or quality cannot be estimated, because since it was a thread of light it was not possible to penetrate and to define, not even to have details. 42 In that immense abyss everything is infinite in its beauty, everything immense in its magnificence. || I must also say that every time I am more supplied with light and I find myself higher. As I come back I am able to describe my ideas less clearly. That was what happened on the day of the Body of the Lord. I saw these very bright souls but I was unable to describe them; their beauty was magnificent, there were others less bright and their glory was less.

43 Nothing else could be said. Maybe the blessed, the good souls could describe it, but I was not able to say what I felt or what I saw. In the nothingness in which I found myself, I have nothing because everything is rejected before the wall of my sins or rather my infamies of which it seems I am covered. ||

The supreme Good, divine physician

Today, while I was feeling faint because of the closeness of my Beloved, I said: move aside, you are killing me!

Fear shook me, fear of being noticed. When this was over I received such an acute blow on my breast that only the strength that I received earlier could sustain me. My

Good, what strength you gave me!

A bit earlier I was studying to discover the essence of perfection; how to absorb the latest drop of the very bitter chalice of tribulations. I was in the church. After some time this dagger pierced me through. Here I am to practice it, my Love! What did I do? Soon in silence I accepted it; my humanity twisted, it wanted help, it searched to give vent:

  • No, my Beloved! Are you happy? Is your heart satisfied?

44 An intimate voice said to me this: ||

  • I like it, this is the real death.

Remaining in this way, it seemed to me that it was not I who lived but a spirit for me lived, as it happened many other times. How sweet it is to live in Jesus resigned to the will of God! Today brings pains of one kind, tomorrow of another, today a cross with thorns, tomorrow with nails. All of them are planted by Jesus! It is certain that, if our dear Love uses such sharp blades he will also give us the strength to receive the wounds and will not allow them to destroy us. And if that should happen, we would find delight in having been the victims of our Beloved. But when I go to him weeping, I show him my wounds, the agony that tormented me. My Good, heal me –I say to him – the torments I experience are very bitter. He has always been my physician || and comes to heal me.

45 I remember once when a metallic instrument wounded me in one part of my body, when I saw the wound I thought it could become gangrenous. I uncovered it and I said: my Beloved, heal me or at least take away the inflammation that nothing may happen to me. As I said this the pain stopped, the wound became white and after fifteen days it got healed without putting anything on it. A thousand such things happen to me. 46 Now the heavy iron belt that I carry tears the flesh and often while I want it to be embodied in the flesh, in removing it I see a deep dark wound. The burning agonizes me but much more is the delight that I feel finding myself bound to the heart of my all, to the Being of my life. Who can explain || his love, the effects it produces? I am very ignorant and I am not able.

“I am alone, I have lost my Being!”

My God what a dread! Jesus loves me no more; an abyss of imperfections is before me. Waves as those of the sea in tempest oppress my soul.

Jesus does not love me any more! This feeling strangles me, it kills me. I wept secretly and if I was not in community I would destroy myself. What can I do? Alas, I am alone, I have no one and the worst is that I lost my Being!

A thousand deaths, my God! Pierce me with a thousand daggers but do not abandon me for pity’s sake. 47 Tell me that you regret to discover me in this great sea of infamy, that is, what you do not want and it is the cause of a great abyss of evil. ||

Oh, if I knew they were my eyes I would be ready to draw them out; I would give my life which is so painful for me, a thousand, thousand eyes I would draw out.9

I have always hated you, a foul mule of mine, and now I do not know what I would do to you. You, yes, you were the enemy that removed me from Jesus!

Oh, Eternal Father, if this is the cup which you ask me to drink, may I swallow it all at once because it would be too painful to swallow in many sips. 48 Have mercy! If you desire it, patience: I am ready to swallow it even in small drops, not being worthy to gulp it down as my Saviour did. ||

“Oh, sweet death, to die consumed by this fire!”

Date 14 (…). Alas, the whole day I was consumed! The chest was being snatched, and the bones breaking. My

God, what are you doing? You kill me! I had also the fortune of receiving a small humiliation: in truth I did not think that in that saying there could be humiliation but as soon as I knew it, I took it with joy. The joy that my God made me feel was such that I cannot but exclaim: my

Beloved, for so little you give me so much! For a small thing you pay me back with a precious coin, my Good! Oh, yes, he loves me and he did not leave me; he who lives for me, my Spirit lives in me. || 49 Today everything was fire, I bathed and yet I was consumed. Oh, sweet death, to die consumed by this dear fire!

Today, every pain was of comfort, every anguish dearest, because my All, the Being of my life sustained me.

Selfishness, a thief that steals the good of good souls

In hearing a certain story of a person, who thought or admitted certain thing to be too difficult to be done because of humiliation, I was surprised and I thought within myself: how can this monster reach to such an extent even in such a good soul? Could it happen? I felt a dread to think where this subtle pride and selfishness can reach. || 50 I feel great pain, because it is like the thief that steals the good of the good souls, who work with much zeal and charity – it seems incredible – much work of charity, much labor, and then to see them victims of theft, of their good, because it took everything with it and the poor soul remained with nothing. Desolation, great blindness, because these poor creatures languish like this.

The reason depends on the unwillingness to place their own will and judgment in the hands of those who lead them. When will the light come for these blind souls! 51 I cannot express how much pain I felt seeing them so blind. Oh, if I could make them feel || a little bit of what I feel when I receive humiliations! Then it seems to me that all could desire them and they would act like the thirsty in search for water.

Night beasts and ghosts. Raptures

Date 21 July, 1878. My God, what a night! Some days ago a swarm of flies appeared to me. The ceiling was so full of black flies that the room became dark. When these disappeared the room became white, but yesterday night I was sleeping when a shaking woke me up. I opened my eyes and I saw the usual beast with long clutches. It was nearing my bed but it did not move the clutches at all; as it came closer it faded away and disappeared.

52 Again I started to recite the rosary and at the end before || Hail holy Queen I slept. Again perhaps after half an hour of sleep I woke up by the same shaking.

I do not know what happened to me, that I remained awake as if I did not sleep at all. Again the same beast, darker and uglier, was at the back of the bed attached to the wall. Alas, what does it ever mean! I held myself tight to my beloved Jesus.

Yesterday also I had a day of agony, today a strong union with my God that at a certain moment I had to distract myself, but luckily nobody realized.

My right side was swollen and the pain I felt was so much that my ribs were raised up. 53 What a pain to be in community and more so to occupy || this place. For the mercy of God the Father, until now nobody realized what I was experiencing. When I am very united and enraptured in him there is nobody in the church; otherwise he waits until I am in my room. Oh, continue my Good, because it could be very sorrowful if they could realize certain things!

What noises, my God! They already started in this room. The weariness is such that the shakings seem to me to be very numerous. Oh, it is a year now since things have become different.

Nothing impressed me, but now I say instead everything impresses me as in this moment that I move the chair were I am seated. What a pain! I am tormented from all sides, and by now the sufferings || are enjoyable.

54 Yesterday, and I could say always, when I lay on the cross, the feet, the hands, and the side were stricken by such an enjoyable pain, that for a long time I remained absorbed in God. How dear they are to me! That evening when they are not strong, I regret and I feel greater pain. This night I still felt nothing; but last evening I was disturbed by the noise. The ugly beast appeared to me; it was smaller to frighten me more and it was coming closer. Three times my Being told me not to fear, that the ugly spirit would do nothing. 55 These words came down very strongly to me || while the ugly spirit shook me and prevented me from sleep. However, I was not frightened at all and looking at it I slept. What strength your words have, my Beloved!

“How pure is the school of my Good!”

The following nights I was afraid of a certain specific matter of mine that might occur. I felt a sweet closeness and the side of the heart was already united as happens often, that seems the ribs rise up in that moment. My God, tell me why this happens in me. Why can’t I have clear explanation?

He did not delay to consent to my wish and with much clarity he explained everything. How pure || his school! 56 It originates from that most pure love which cannot be described; in this way everything is seen without any dimming of any kind. My Good! If when I am in that perfect union I could say a word of this taste and purity!

The day before yesterday, while I was alone in the church, I heard a sweet sound as if something arrived in the air. My eyes were turned to heaven when a person appeared to me that I was not able to distinguish. I could not because it had not a human shape. But I heard: it was just that thing for which I prayed in that moment, a grace I desired most. With loud voice it said:

  • 57 They are approved!

Alas, my Eternal Father || through this you make me repeat what you had already showed me. Already approved, my God?

I did not fail in trust, but the desire and the anxiety of soon seeing and possessing what I desired most kept me always in pain. Now I am calmer and I want to rest upon your heart.10

In those days I had other words and suggestions on the Work of God. I experienced four days of pain in which I was bombarded in soul and body by devils who wanted to intimidate me. But my God sustained me with his purest love and more so it made me languish. The Being who lives for me delighted me to a point of making me die. Sweet death! Alas, my Good, do not come closer: I am dying! 58 The ribs on the right side are breaking, no one was aware of my illness. ||

How much light he gave me! It is true that part of this light through which I see certain things, particularly relevant to the Order, agonize me but I also have the consolation that seeing them on time I can put some remedy.

A skeleton written “Obbe” on the palm of the hand

Today as on all the other days I felt worn out. What a sense of fatigue I felt today, not immediately, but after when

I thought of it. A big skeleton appeared to me! When I asked it if it came to take me, it answered:

  • I cannot.

  • What then do you want?

  • Nothing – it answered.

  • Why don’t you take me?

It lifted up the right hand and on the palm this word was written: Obbe.

  • I cannot – it replied and then it vanished.

At the time I did nothing but after I thought much on it.

Alas, this side is always more || undone!

59 I also recalled all the lessons I had in the past days in order not to forget Father Bernardo, my Rosa11 and all the things that my God, my all, the Being of my life deigned to give me. What pains I felt! In some moments I could say that I was in agony. Last night, lying in bed and tired as I was, I could sleep.

In fact, I gently slept, as I lay. A shaking woke me; I opened my eyes and looked here and there. A big beast was opposite my cross at the back of the feet; it was very big and was stationary. 60 After some minutes it started || moving slowly and went towards the right side of the ceiling and it quickly disappeared. Soon I felt like leaping from the cross and running away but I remained immobile or rather incapable of moving, because the fear I felt was very strong. The beast went through the ceiling and disappeared.

The reaction I felt was such that the fear did not cease but in addition a convulsion assailed me. I suffered and I did not understand the reason. It suggested to me nothing good. Enough! After a long time of pain I turned to the Crucifix I kept with me as I lay: my Good, how much I suffer!

61 I also said other things united to my || Good, Being of my life.

Jesus: “Do not be afflicted, you will have everything”

2nd September 1872. There were some days that the houses of the Holy Mother St. Anne Mother of the Immaculate were without means, and I was feeling great anguish. The more the commitments increased the more I felt tortured.

This morning before Holy Communion, when I was weeping at the feet of my Beloved, he told me these words:

  • Do not be tormented, you will have everything.

  • 62 Oh, Love, my Good, will I have your providence? ||

  • Yes, my Rosa, be calm.

I became serene and a sweet union absorbed me in God. Having recovered, I was strong. I could challenge an army. I felt that I had nothing more to fear. In receiving Holy Communion, since it was Wednesday I did it for St. Joseph; even he made me feel that everything was for the Work of St. Anne and that I will have everything. Come, my dear protector, bring it to me; do not delay, come!

Speaking in this way it seemed as if I spoke to him face to face, while it was faith and the union that my soul enjoyed with God. In him I understood everything and delighted. As soon as I reached home I found providence in the first letter that I opened.

63 In this way || the whole day and even now which is almost evening I am continuing to receive gifts of providence. How good is my Beloved, the Being of my life:

he does everything and he lives for me.

“Without knowing of living I lived in my Being”

Today, 10 September: for several days I have been tormented by strong pains, from head to feet, and in addition I was strongly assailed by terrible temptations.

There were moments in which I agonized; I suffered very cruel pains. I was not able to understand anything.

When I was feeling lost, a light passed before my eyes. It lasted for a minute, a second: the Blessed Virgin Mary with the Child in her arms could be distinguished. This scene disappeared and light appeared again or rather my cloud appeared. Nothing was heard from it but it was enough to clear my mind of all that || whirling in which I was wrapped.

64 The following night, was a night of contemplation rather than sleep. Finally at four in the morning I started the meditation and the union was such that I held close to my God. I began to taste the sweetness of heaven; the right side was already beginning to swell. Alas, you are killing me! I could say nothing else, because all my powers were in him alone, and tightly, without knowing that I was alive, I lived in that Being, for in that moment only he was in me and I knew nothing, saw nothing: I only felt myself rejoicing.

In this way returning to this world I noticed that my left side was swollen; it has grown big and painful.65 12 As usual || the pains were transformed into joy the most terrible tribulations were my consolation. The same morning it occurred in Holy Communion.

While slowly I was feeling united with my All, the Being of my life, I had a strong fear. My Good, until today you gave me the grace to hide these things from the sight of the world. Do you leave me now? My Good, have pity on me! Saying this it seemed me that a hand turned me away raising me from that state and took away my Good.

God always comes to our help with his “providence”

66 One morning before Communion I prayed fervently for providence asking my eternal Being to grant me and send me what I am in need of. || I was almost insisting, overtaken by the fear of not receiving it. While I was like this a voice said to me:

  • Do not fear, my Rosa, why do you do this?

I kept quiet and full of courage, as if I had already received everything, I thanked my Eternal Father for the grace he gave me and as if I had everything in the pocket joyfully I went to work.

This morning, while I waited for confession, I felt the urge to say a word to my blessed Rosa:

  • My daughter, why is providence delaying? It seems to me it should have already been on the table? Why? Why?

Alas, again I was in anguish; 67 but she calmly said:

  • My mother, || it will come soon, do not fear.

Therefore God the Father will send me everything. She was very cheerful, sign of a consoling event; I almost felt it, because it seemed that she communicated something of consolation and said:

  • I also share in your joy.

The “courier of bad time”

Today 15 October, within me I had a sweet cheerfulness which I do not know how to keep inside, so that, they will not know. I was afraid because I felt it increasing and I could not contain myself from saying something funny. In the midst of much suffering, here is what made me laugh.

68 For 25 days I did not see the ugly beast which brought me much fear and had news of painful consequences; it seemed –

I called it – the courier of bad || times, because for some days, bad news or much tribulations took place in the Institute.

For a long time, in the hands I did not feel that nice smell and when it was like this I felt stronger pain, but the delight is much greater. This was yesterday, or rather the day before yesterday; it started being felt yesterday and today it was stronger. I had also received great lights to see certain pretences or rather while certain people spoke to me; I was enlightened to see the duplicity of their hearts even in the smallest things.

What a sweet Master, dearest Spouse: you are the Being of my life. 69 Yes, the || graces which you give me are immense, but I pay you back differently! Alas, cover me, my Beloved, with the mantle of your mercy! Oh, never uncover me, so that I do not disgust you!

“Heaven was of bronze, everything rebelled against me”

Today my pain was such that I feared much for my head;

last night a crowd of thoughts assailed me so much that I did not know how I was. I only became aware that I was raving; I wanted to come out from that state but my efforts were not successful. Finally after much struggle I drowsed.

Again as I recovered, all the past seemed to me a sleep and within me I tried to see if my mind was ever calm, and it was, but it was || empty.

70 I was not able to think of anything, not even what I usually did when I woke up, that is meditation; nothing.

In this way I lay tired. At the end I woke up and went to the church. When I was in the presence of the living God, I was taken by melancholy and a pain that ‘killed’ me. I did not know what to say any more. An abyss of thoughts, a presentation before me of all the least imperfections and everything was becoming so grave that in truth I could not bear it. I was arid, I felt nothing, heaven was of bronze, and everything rebelled against me.

71 I was lost in the midst of much oppression. || Alone I had no word of comfort from anyone; alone, alone in the midst of such a great Work.

Everyday the tribulations increased and I had new labor. For me nothing could be toil. If only I knew of laboring well and not destroying; and so many souls, how can I direct them? The responsibility of these, how will I manage before the court of God?

Alone, without anyone to whom I can say a word of what my soul suffers. It is impossible to describe my suffering and I had to swallow everything and strain so that nobody may realize my state. 72 What I feel breaks my breast. I run for a minute to my room and prostrate on the ground I ask || for help. Oh, if I could weep, how I could be happy. My poor mind would suffer much less!

Though I remained in this state throughout the day, I did not cease praying. This evening I felt such an injury in my poor breast that I thought I would remain under such martyrdom. What suffering!

Always trustfully waiting for “providence”

Today while in pain I wept at the feet of my God so that he might send me his providence and I prayed to my advocate.

This is what she told me:

  • Why are you anguished? Providence will come.

After some time I said:

  • You are right but you need to be in my place, with many expenses and needs without anything.

She replied:

  • Be patient, it will come.

73 Within me I continued to say – everything is well - || but I feel an indescribable anguish.

However, I felt my mind was gathering and slowly I was gaining much peace.

At the bedside of a gravely sick superior

Today 26 October, it is a day of tribulations.

A superior was gravely sick: As soon as I entered the church for the Communion, a power pushed me to return to the house and it told me many things, but being so thoughtful I did not understand. It said:

  • Go and administer Viaticum to her, the oil of the sick.

And I asked:

  • Will she die?

  • No, she will be healed.

What a contradiction! I was turning on all sides to see if there would be something as a sign of death, like a star or a skeleton that I could see. Nothing appeared to me. 74 Finally when I was beside the bed of the sick and prayed raising my eyes to || heaven an angel appeared to me with a beautiful crown of roses in his hand. My God!

This is what I said:

  • My angel, whose is this crown? Therefore, she will die:

is it for this sick person?

  • He did not answer; he only showed me that the crown missed some roses.

  • Therefore, does she still need to work?

He said nothing, and he disappeared. I said something to the sick: she had to complete her crown on the bed of suffering or she will recover. I made her make a promise to the Lord and I remained serene about her future. This morning I saw other things in a confused way but I am calm. 75 I only felt sick on the side of the heart because today

|| it was very swollen. Last night I was very united with my

God in the Sacrament, perhaps that might be the cause.

Strong fears of being damned

Alas, I am arid, confused, I see many things but I can distinguish nothing; an unrest disturbs my mind. I do not know which party I should take. As an insensate I live, work and pray.

I remained always in this way for various days when I was caught by a strong fear of being damned. This was not enough. Very confused and obstinate temptations were added but nothing was helpful in driving them away.

76 In these there was a certain mixture of mistrust in faith. This was not clear, but it gave me more pain than all the others. Even now, I could think of || nothing in order not to forget.

Again the writing “Obbe” on the right hand of a dying sister

When the sister who was dying, some minutes before her death, gave the signs, she adjusted herself in exactly the same manner as that death which appeared to me a month and half ago. What sense it gave me when she adjusted herself that way!

For two good times she made that gesture spreading the arm in the air, the way that skeleton did which appeared to me in my room. In this way she kept the right hand and the left useless like that skeleton; it seemed she could not move it. On the palm of the hand that she was moving, I could distinguish these words: Obbe.

77 That was a word which I did not understand; only these four letters were clearly visible, but not the first. || In this way I was not able to see the portrait but when this creature prepared herself to die, she was taking the portrait of that skeleton. The only difference was that the skeleton was a bit meager and the face longer.

“Will I be damned? Hell is open for me”

Now in these days the tribulations were so many that my poor head could not have borne them, if my God did not sustain me with his powerful arm. 78 Even my spirit echoed the temporal tribulations because they were much greater. The fact being that I did not find my Beloved and the thought of being myself the cause of his withdrawal frightens me; it does not give me rest. My breast is of bronze because || it has no tears; it does not feel anything but a torturing pain. The brain

… the upsetting is such that there are moments that I want to tear it; I realize that I want to say one thing and I say another thing.

On ninth, at night, I lay down almost desperate and much upset because for me everything was lost, not being able either to see or to hear my Being.

Therefore will I be damned? For me hell is open; how can I receive Holy Communion tomorrow when I risk a sacrilege? Hell is open only for me.13

I kissed my Crucifix, my Good, what did I do? Did you not like what I do? Therefore I work for Satan? Alas, if I could see that to be true, I would throw everything to the ground and I would care for nothing more! ||

79 Before I lay I made a brief visit to my God through a small window that I have in the room: what have I done to you my dear Good? I lay almost desperate; I had only thoughts of people who asked me what good I did in the Work.

What did I do? I drove them away with force: Go away, I do not want you! Saying this was as if I said within myself:

  • Perhaps, are you the ones who took away my Being?

Turning to the wall where the tabernacle is: Well, you are here; since I cannot do any other thing, I will stay gazing at your dwelling.14

80 As I said this, I started doing it. Slowly I was feeling my unrest || calmed and I started saying a few words to my Crucifix and he seemed to listen to me. Again turning to the Blessed Sacrament I was absorbed in him.

After a long time I said: alas, you are killing me, the left side was very swollen and was so painful that I did not know if I was agonizing or living. Alas, my Good! These were the only words that I could say.

After some hours, I was in a trance and slowly it seemed to me that I was raised in the air with my God. I remained like that until morning.

81 Various experiences, temptations, tribulations

For three months now the pain of the right side has been almost always my || companion. In these days I understood many things and my Being comforted me much.

Yesterday morning while I prayed for a Daughter of St. Anne Mother of the Immaculate, who died, I asked my God to free her from purgatory:

  • My daughter, tell me something, where are you?

She answered:

  • Mother, I suffer much!

What pain I felt! As if something unhappy fell down upon me. I had mastered myself so that no one could realize.

Last evening coming back to my room on the kneeler, where one kneels I saw the head of a dead person. As soon as I saw it, it disappeared. Who will die?

For two days now a very small star has been going around me.

82 For three months I have not seen frightening || beasts, not even small ones.

In the morning the usual continues to take place, that is when my Jesus does not want me any more, he pushes me out and if I resist, a crowd of thoughts and temptations assail me that I am forced to flee. Many times I go for work and not finding anything important, I say: it is the devil but before I finish, an affair is presented which requires immediate attention; otherwise it would turn bad. Now I am used to it and it makes not much sense. I confess that many times I would let go of certain things in order to stay with my God.

I am plunged in the most sorrowful tribulations; it seems to me to be || drowned. 83 Something I cannot explain sustains me. I see nothing; I feel nothing yet a sensible power sustains me. I feel there is something great and powerful in me.

Jesus: “Prepare yourself for great tribulations”

1 15, 1872.15 I wanted to remove the cross over the bed where I sleep, and determined to do so I was getting ready to remove it. I took the Crucifix in my arms, I kissed it and held it tightly to my breast: oh, my Love, love me, because I love you so much!

I was almost placing it and I had already removed the blankets and whatever was on the iron, when a voice that shook me fully loudly said: I will stay there!

Very frightened, soon I arranged the bed to the best that I could and immediately I lay down; I spent a night of paradise.

Two nights after this had happened to me, it seemed to me I could rest but there were many voices which disturbed me; I understood nothing, only murmuring.

2 Finally they kept quiet and joyfully I started to pray; another voice as a stormy thunder upset me. It said: ||

  • Prepare yourself for great tribulations, because those you went through are few and nothing in comparison to these. First you will obtain what you wish, and this is what will cost you dearly.

An abyss of sufferings, persecutions, they were of all kinds; unfortunately, it must be true, because for two days my Beloved caressed me. I was prepared for everything.

When I saw so much suffering I did not know how I could resist. I was to absorb thousands and numberless things.

Alas, I feel enough oppressed by tribulations, my Good!

Certainly your strength sustains me to move ahead.

Light on the direction of the religious

Two days ago, he furnished me with extraordinary light in particular on the direction of the religious. 3 When I was in the chapter where || they had to accuse themselves for the failings imposed by the Rule, the spirit that enlightened me was such that, I could say, I read clearly within their hearts. To see them closed to the truth, to hear these creatures with my ears disgusted me. He even assigned me someone who was false. These displeased me and while I was feeling that, the desire to cry was growing within me:

  • Wretched, what are you doing?

I controlled myself and I only said this with a severe voice:

  • I will make your accusations!

I cannot express what I felt; I was feeling strangled. The more I tried to control the more the fire grew within me that I was boiling from head to foot.

  • My God – I repeated, within me – give me strength, help!

4 While coming out of the chapter – and by the grace of my Jesus I was called, otherwise I would have drowned - ||

I was as insensate, unable even to speak.

Oh, how many times, in these days my God spoke to me, regarding the religious. Regarding the spiritual exercises that they do, he is not very happy with most of them.

A powerful Spirit supports and governs me Last evening, while I prayed, I was interiorly afflicted because I had no one I could say a word to. A voice said to me: “Why do you say this? Do you not remember what I told you a little before you received such a defeat from Rome? I am your Master, be calm.”

5 The peace of mind I felt in the midst of so many tribulations and anguishes of all kinds is such that I see there is a powerful Spirit who supports and governs me. It is painful when he sends me out of the church; I go obedient || and cheerful.

My Good, do you send me to work? Here I am to obey you though it costs me much.

Raptures, Swelling on the right side

After five days of anguish for having lost my Being, the diabolic suggestions were such that they were dragging me on every side. Even the body was feeling the torments. On the sixth day, I felt some kind of relief, but I understood nothing. I went to the church and I abandoned myself at the feet of my Jesus; I was dumb, but the intellect was in spasms and my soul was feeling the approaching of its God. In this way I stayed there a quarter of an hour. It seemed to me that a gentle closeness enraptured me. I was able to learn many things. At the end I remained peaceful.

6 I spent the night with my Jesus and this sweet union grew so that it even seemed to take away every pain. And then as before || I said: alas, you are killing me! The ribs were rising up on the right side and the swelling grew more.

Last night, while I was lying under the spasms of a headache my friar Francis appeared to me; he said nothing; he only passed cheerfully and went away.16

Today I have been united to my God to the degree that if I did not distract myself I would be feeling enraptured.

My Beloved, wait for me until I reach the room; then you can kill me. How many beautiful things he said and taught me especially on the Work: What I should do even with the outside people. How many caresses when he says:

“My Rosa, courage for I am with you, do not doubt.”

“My Rosa, do not fear, you will have everything;

I note down every breath of yours”

7 I started the novena of Christmas. I promised my Beloved to increase the penances, to climb on the straight cross and remain on it until I am tired; to increase || the discipline until bleeding or until I have strength and many other penances in the whole body. I promised to my God and tomorrow I will continue to do as he taught me.

I prayed for providence; an interior voice said to me:

Today you will have everything. The next day the same voice said to me:

My Rosa, do not fear, you will have everything; every breath of yours I note down.17

Finally, yesterday the fire devoured me; the left side made me die out of the closeness of my God. Alas! I tried to distract myself and by din of forcing myself today I felt very exhausted, I had no strength.

For two days a star had been moving around me. I understood nothing of what it meant with its sparkling radiance. 8 I heard a voice telling me that || a Daughter of St.

Anne was in paradise.

14 The small room of Piacenza adjoined the chapel. During the night Mother Rosa turned her acts of adoration and affection to the tabernacle through a small window opened on the wall.

15 The manuscript does not indicate the month, but from the context it can be deduced that it was 15 November.
