From the beginning of 1873, the notes always more frequent, became almost a diary; they could be followed month after month even with an approximate chronology, thanks to the indication of days and months.

In the pages written within the month of June and at the beginning of July, we find expressions full of desire to finish the earthly exile to be definitively united to the supreme Good. In fact we know that in the month of July she stayed in bed seriously sick. But as soon as she became convalescent, Mother Rosa again took up her activities, the bodily mortifications and also her auto-reflections through writing.

Though the vicissitude of the Constitutions continued to weigh on her spirit, the Foundress seems to live serenely the painful awaiting, the sufferings and the internal struggles. She felt guided by a superior light in the direction of the Work of God whose future she looks with confidence.

She stayed entire nights in contemplation: “Her vigils of love.” But in her journeys when she had to share the same room with the sisters, she longed the freedom of her cameretta of Piacenza where she could abandon herself to the vehemence of love without fear of being seen. At the end of December during her stay in the eternal city she wrote: “Rome, for me you have become my exile, because in this house I could not do my penances…It is too painful for me to live in common in the rooms.”

MS 4.1 – pp. 8 – 120

Vision of the Child Jesus and of St. Anne. Other apparitions

Last night, the first day I was in bed, I prayed. A light appeared to me and with it a child turned to the wall; I did not see him well but as soon as I asked who he was it turned: it was my Jesus, my Good, my All.

  • Tell me, what do you want, did I do bad to lie down?

He gave me a look of complaisance and he disappeared.

I remained in the dark and continued to pray. A dying man appeared to me, with something on his head.

  • Who are you?

He answered nothing, but he left me fearful and without strength; if I would not have been fortified before by my Jesus… Again there was a light and soon I saw a lady with a veil on her head, I could say like St. Anne. She was seated on my bed, turned to the wall. As soon as I saw her:

  • 9 Holy Mother, my dear Mother St. Anne, what did I do? Tell me something, speak to me!

I said all the words interruptedly. Only looking at her cherished me, I was quiet. She answered nothing. Since behind the wall of the room there was the church || and the Sacrament, soon I thought:

  • Oh, Mother, you make the adoration for me!

Then she turned making a sign that she was not looking at the wall of the church, but toward where there was another person sleeping.

  • Why are you staring?

She kept her eyes open staring on him:

Be calm, that I keep him in sight, my eyes never depart.

She was serious as if she put power with her gaze in order to prevent him from doing the least evil; she was unhappy in looking at him. With me she was full of love and she comforted me; interiorly I felt these words:

  • Be calm, do not fear what you are unable to do I will do; and she comforted me. She disappeared and again I was left in the dark. Finally another much smaller light appeared; I hardly saw the subject which was an old woman who just died. I then asked:

  • Who are you? Who are you? You frighten me! Why did you come?

She was as || if on my bed.

  • 10 Will I die?

She opened an eye as a dying person and again she closed it, but I saw only the bust without the hands. I paused looking at the face to see if I could identify her. She left me unrest so strong that I was unable to sleep anymore. What pain!

I prayed, but I was always thoughtful; who could this be? My God, this night how many visitors came! I saw all these with my eyes.

My God – I went repeating – have pity on me, only your mercy can sustain me; I am plunged into an abyss of thousands of miseries and there are moments in which I am completely lost. Alas, what a pain my God to have offended you! I am an abyss of infamies!

Some days ago I saw another soul whom I loved much and who remained very much in my mind. Finally when I was in the church:

  • Tell me if you are already in paradise. ||

11 A very light cloud appeared to me and inside it there was something, though I was not able to distinguish anything. I did not understand well what it said: “I will go” or “I am there” but it was joyful. I blessed the Lord.

The vow not to eat sweet things does not please God

Another day I prayed for providence. In concluding the thanksgiving, a voice came closer to me and said:

  • You will do like this.

Soon I put into practice such suggestions and I obtained everything. Oh, my Master, how good you are and I am so miserable! When I think of this anguish, humiliation for my nothingness comes to me. To see the goodness of my God, what I feel! If I could explain, I would say what I feel but being ignorant I must keep quiet.

Today while I was in the dining room, I thought to take some of the sweet stuff; soon I felt something:

  • My Good, what do you say?

I stopped.

  • 12 I will not only leave it, but if you want I will take a vow never to taste it anymore; || no.

This I was never able to do. He added other words.

  • No, you will need it.

I remained thoughtful.

  • My Love, when will I take it?

After saying these words, what did my Good make me experience! If the fire had increased, the sisters would have realized; but soon I asked to be given the book for the reading.

The archangel Raphael is close to her in the journey to Foligno and Rome

Last night I woke up I do not know at what time. Immediately my thought directed to the tabernacle. With the thought that the affections were united and soon I was tightly united to my God. 13 My right side seemed to be pulled up and taken inside the Being that dwells in the tabernacle.

Tightly united, it stayed for two or more hours because a very long time had passed || before they came to call me for holy Mass and for meditation.

Though it was very late, even today I felt such union with God that if it were not for the many occupations that prevent me, I could be continually absorbed in my Good. Oh, Jesus, my Sacrament, how good you are with me so disgraceful!

As I finished the Communion, before leaving for Foligno – Rome, I asked my Eternal Father to help me in everything and to give me the fortune to have a good journey.1 In the meantime I was speaking to him in this way: - Stretch out your right hand and defend me from perils – something came before me to my amazement or rather confusion, but I scarcely understood; maybe he gave me an angel as a helper. Everything ended; only when I was having the vapor did this thing come back to me clearer. 14 My God, who is this angel: || let me see him! But I saw nothing.

At last I realized there were two of them, but I could not clearly make out what they looked like. I reached a town where I stayed overnight; while I slept I was taken by an intimate union with God that I was dying. I remained this way the whole night; after a very brief time again I was absorbed in tight union. Finally in the morning I went to take Communion and after a little while I prayed:

  • My Good, who is that angel I saw near me? I see two: a big one and a smaller one; what is his name? Who is he?

A very distinct voice answered me:-

  • 15 “He is mine.”

In that moment the light was very clear enabling me to see the Child Jesus and from || his mouth that yes came out. How much it consoled me to listen to this! It was my dear Good and me so disgraceful and always, always wicked; my God, what pain this is!

The more I see myself deformed the closer my God comes to me. Oh, do not be shocked, have pity on me my Good. What horror! I conclude otherwise I may suffer too much.

Ecstatic union and total absorption

25 January 1873. Today I enjoyed peace more than usual. A star from some days ago is before me now and then announcing the death of a Daughter of St. Anne; this is clear and sure because it happened many times.

When it is about other people, as I already said a black cross appears to me. Only once this cross appeared white but that person was very devoted to St. Anne Mother of the Immaculate.

16 This night, the union with my God || was such that, when it ceased, I found myself in this world in which I would never believe to return to live in.

I saw nothing, I felt nothing: alone, absorbed in the Being in whom everything is contained, I did not understand living. I was all in him without seeing or hearing anything but feeling every kind of beatitude. It did not come all at once but gradually; alas, I could not do other than say: my God, you make me die!

Foresight of the peace of the Church and of the vocations to the Order of St. Francis Some days ago in the distance I saw peace for the

Church and in addition, the beautiful vocations that were to come in the Order of St. Francis, as well as among the nuns; but everything was very distant.2

While I was in this state I asked about the Work of God but he went away, because he wanted me to leave || soon for work; 17 but a voice said to me:

  • Another time you will see this.

In the midst of joy and suffering I feel the announcement of something. Yesterday I was devoured by the fire on the left side; I wanted to bathe but I suffered the most I could because I had no alternative.

My Jesus who is so good had always granted me this. In the same way the arms; especially the right one, although less sacrificed than the left, I felt much pain in the scars. The pain in the hands is as usual.

The angel my Jesus gave me guards me very well. It seems that he gave me more strength and life to be able to do everything without going to bed; he defends me. Oh, you are strong and powerful, my dear Raphael!3

18 I am like a hedgehog and I become always a smaller being much protected || by him. I know more my nothingness, and humiliated I hold to myself not having the courage of raising my head not to say “what do I do” but “what do you make me do my Good, eternal All!”

Certainty of being guided by “my All”

26 January 1873. I spent the whole night with Jesus in the Sacrament exposed on the altar; tightly united with him, I adored him. The union continued this morning before receiving him. While I was tightly united with my God, my cloud appeared to me. This time it opened and I saw very clearly my eternal All who laid his right hand on my head. 19 I remained inebriated, assured of being guided by him. All the doubts which I had in my examination yesterday and the thousand fears that || disturbed me ceased; I am now calm.

Oh, my Master, you know how to dispel quickly every fear and bring peace, comfort and strength to the soul. In the sea of worries and anguishes in which I am in the Work and activity, if it were not for your strength, certainly no creature could bear it.

The swelling of the left side: No one should realize!

For two days – 5 and 6 February – such is the swelling of the left side, that it seemed to me a special grace that a moment did not come in which the creatures could realize it. I stayed as someone who is hiding something and always fears that the moment could come that it is discovered.

Furthermore there were moments in which it burned. I did not have even the fortune of bathing because the humidity spreads and the lung suffers much and then I have spasms of pain.

20 My Beloved, remember the promise, || that no one should realize! Have pity, my Good!

At night I stared praying and I passed from meditation to union. Oh, night, I could well say that you are the garden of my delights! Only that I woke up much more tired than when I went to bed because of having failed to sleep.

Intercessions for a Daughter of St. Anne

Four days ago a Daughter of St. Anne appeared to me and she lamented much; she asked me to relieve her. I saw her very oppressed and she said that was because she had been a superior she had many sufferings. She pleaded with me so much that I felt pain and I said:

  • I promise to receive the Communion for you once every week, if you obtain for me this… in addition you will have a sung Mass in our chapel in Piacenza.

For the Communions I offered, I saw her rejoicing, but for the Sacrifice not so much as I || expected. 21 I questioned her to know the reason, but she did not answer. I asked:

  • Can’t this free you quickly?

She did not give any reply; she was gloomy. Finally I said to her:

  • I will ask the Father to celebrate for you.

Oh, she was very happy and I could see how acceptable the Sacrifice of this religious was before God.

  • You will have everything – she told me – very consoled.

I do not speak of my Serafina, because with her I find very much to be done particularly for what is temporal. How much light my God provided for me around this time! How clear he showed me certain handlings. The thing which causes me most pain is when they say one thing and in their hearts they have another one. Because of the unfortunate position I hold, I cannot even say anything but I suffer much.

22 The eve of Our Lady of Purification || was a day of delights. My God, how much strength I need so that they may not realize! My God!

For some days I saw more than two people holding powwow among themselves against the Work of St. Anne. This thing made me suffer; there were moments in which I felt like fainting though I do all that is possible not to be discovered.

“My ribs rise up.” The big chain in the flesh

Today my Jesus comforted me coming very close to me. Alas, the ribs of my left side rose very much and the swelling became stronger. I also had a strong pain in the hands and feet that I felt it much. What about the arm? What a slash I carry! It seemed that in all the scars a hot blade of || iron passed through and opened them!

23 Last night I was much consoled: the big chain caused me much pain because a piece of flesh was raised up. When I tried to raise this flesh, I felt shivering, but as soon as I said something to my Good and turned my mind to my God in whom I always keep united, I enjoyed things that I am not able to express. After some time, it seemed to me that my Being cured me because I felt no more pain. Interiorly I understood a thousand things and it was my Jesus who made me feel that my torment pleased him. 24 Oh, world, you who know so little of this language; your ethics || is very different from that of God! You admit the keeping of the flesh and to my God nothing else is pleasing than its destruction for his love under the scourge of flagellation. I never wanted much than when I was hanging down on the cross and all the times

I came down, it was for me a climbing which took me to the sweet apartment of my Good and to his own banquet, because I was given tasteful tidbits.

What a hard deprivation not to be able to lie down and sleep on my cross. Oh, blessed sleep which was always with my Jesus!

25 I speak the truth that I feel compassion for the people of the world because || they do not know that this consolation exists, and I say there could be. Oh, unfortunate, what do you care so much for the flesh which will finish, when you have a soul which will give you, if you know how to enrich it, eternal joy!

Constant help of Anna Serafina

I do not know how to express the contents and how much spiritual sweetness a soul has in paradise, one who was always intent on doing its best for the other with whom it worked on earth. 26 In God it loved perfectly with that purest love which does not have any aim other than to please the purest Being, God. Everything is done to reach that aim;

nothing is desired but to bring the whole world into that abyss so that it may taste it and the creatures may give up worldliness, to fall in love || with God. The sufferings, the struggles, everything is esteemed nothing. Only the thought of God and of his Work was everything to us.

How consoled I was when I was with her since all our discussions were on the Work! I loved her confidence in providence and that certainty she expressed to have in God’s mercy. This is what happens to me now that the Lord called her to him and she already enjoys the fruit of her labor. When I have a moment I turn to her as if I have her close. I reason:

  • My dear daughter…

And other times:

  • My dear Serafina,4 look at what kind of anguish I find myself in, what kind of pains, and always new ones come in the Work of God. Alas, will I have this? Will I have that? How will this affaire end? Do you see how many obstacles || there are on all sides?

27 Finally I tell her everything and then I say to her:

  • I cannot bear it anymore!

As she always used to say when she was still alive, she answers:

  • Mother, you will see that the Lord will send for us everything; do not be disgusted if these do many things to us, the Holy Mother St. Anne will defend you, St. Joseph…

While now she laughs and seems to say:

  • You know everything better than me!

But she never fails comforting me and I must confess that it is true that my Jesus sustains me and there is no trouble in which he is not Master to me.

Some days ago I found myself before a father… and my Jesus supplied me with such light that in every word he said I was able to see his aim. 28 Within me I heard a voice that || suggested to me all that I should reply. The same happened to me with a very proud priest, and as I ended I was upset as if I labored under a press.

Homesickness for her room, place of much penance

The desire I feel to go back soon to the house of Piacenza is such that there are moments in which I must recommend myself to God in order not to faint. At night I would escape; finally I go with my thought and why? To satisfy myself with discipline until bleeding! For many days

I had an indescribable thirst!

Oh, desired moment! If I could have you, I would be satisfied; I cannot bear it anymore! 29 This impulse is such that if I did not turn aside and hold back I would certainly

|| commit imprudence.5

But I remember the promise of my Good that no one will realize what I do. And what pushes me are these noisy days; accustomed to satisfying my God as well as I could and feeling so much pleasure, now not being able to do much, I feel much pain and it seems that I do not have a way of flagellating my body. My God had given me the painful martyrdom of this thirst that I cannot explain. How much I suffer! 30 A thousand torments of flesh, a thousand strikes rather than feel what I am feeling. There are moments in which I faint || and I have to find some kind of excuse to divert the least suspicion.

This strong desire is united with a sweet union with my Good that seeing, tasting his closeness, alas, I would be destroyed! I looked at my body and if I could tear it with my eyes I would do it; and when at night I remained like this I was absorbed in my Being. Deep in my intellect I conceived the desire of crucifying myself. Holding tight my Jesus I meditated when unexpectedly always this desire came alive in my mind. 31 My Good! Meanwhile I was fully absorbed in the wounds of his forehead || made by the crown. This figure was so clear that in my absorption I kissed it.

My Good, if I could take out the skin, my flesh and cure you I would do it and I would satisfy my thirst. My Good I do not know, what I should do. Suggest to me where I can get an instrument to, at least in some way satisfy or just quench my thirst and satisfy your will. You push me, but what can I do if I have nothing! I hardly said this that he suggested to me everything; now I am happy.

How good you are my Good; who could have ever thought that there was a rope and some iron in that trunk and with these || a discipline until bleeding could be done! 32 Blessed be my Being, God for eternity!

Having said this I was full of consolation and enjoyed a happiness of paradise.

Alone, alone! I have no one to whom I can say a word; and who could understand me if I did not submit everything. The whole day I hear nothing other than voices which tell me to care for myself and they make me aware of a thousand obligations of conscience, that I am obliged to care for myself. They know nothing and what they believe is nonsense in comparison to what I do.

My Good, how different your school from that of the human beings!

33 While || I thought – before he suggested to me what I have said above – I decided to draw one of the chains, the small one and to discipline myself. He said a strong no, because I would have finished by bleeding.

Today more than usual the right side tormented me and it was more swollen; that burning which I felt inside burns me and 34 it was in one point as a wound. When it was strong I even felt like fainting. I also see that they realize because they tell me that I change color; that I become || corpselike, I feel stretching all the nerves of the nose, of the eyes and mostly it is because of the great effort I put so that they may not realize, and I always suffer. A thousand deaths rather than someone realize it.

Guided by God in answering to people with a right word

It is now two days that I am aware. I even felt a handling of some people, but my God promised me that I would overcome everything. I only fear one thing: 35 my infamy. But when I am so fearful, my Good calms me with sensible proofs making me aware, if in this period I have ever failed even in the || smallest things, consciously and willingly. I could say more, that is while I am persuaded that I will fail a thousand times, still the mercy of my dear Good does not let me realize it so that I may not be afflicted. This is how I explain all this, but there is in me something very tasteful and ever sweet.

While I speak, many times I can say only one word and omit the rest. It seems that there is something which prevents my saying more. Now, since I am used, as soon as I feel it, I drop the word. 36 Even if this would continue || I remain as if I do not know what to say. I am not bothered at all of the people who say I am foolish while I can please my Good and be happy and in peace. In this way I speak more freely because as soon as I feel this slight opposition, I stop; otherwise I go ahead with confidence and sometimes

I fear that I am too confident.

Anyway after I say:

  • 37 I do what I should not do.

I soon try to examine what || I said. I find nothing and I remain happy with my Jesus, my Beloved, and Being of my life: Yes, I do not live anymore, only you my Good! Enough!

I always want to laugh when he teaches me to make the instruments of penance: how clever are you, my Good!

Wisest Master, because of your great humility you lower yourself to these small things while you do not lack the means to let me have everything you want through your angel!

Alas, my wound tortures me in this moment while I write || and the swelling is greater than on other days.

38 This evening my light announces to me something great but it does not tell me what it is; if it will be consolation or pain. Well, I always prepare myself for the worst so that nothing may be lost, and with these continued anguishes, I may spare the suffering to my Good.

In the offences that you receive my Good, the pains of the Crucifixion are renewed. Can’t I suffer so little torment with you?

I feel much pain in the hand; this evening I finish here. ||

39 A great carnival night in Rome

Alas, it was a great night, the night of 21 of the current month. While the in city of Rome evil people entertained themselves drinking and marry-making, I lay distressed because my strength could not enable me to stay on my feet. I resolved to pray the whole night so that in some way, I could make amends to the suffering of my Jesus that these thoughtless people cause him.

Before I started a spiritual communion a crowd of bad thoughts assailed me. Still more when I was hearing the screaming, it seemed to me that all the worst iniquities came before me; but by the help of God, I always overcame and firm in renewing acts of love, I returned to my spiritual communion.

40 I stayed the whole night awake. In the morning at five I started the || meditation. What I felt on my side, I cannot say, because I do not know how to express but only that the union with my God was very strong.

The same was true of the other prayers of the day, that is meditation. In climbing the stairs of Pilate,6 I tried to collect the blood. Oh, how consoled I was in praying to my Good that he may allow me to keep everything in this heart of his. How many things, what a sweet conversation, what a sacrifice is not to interrupt these precious moments and I can be sure that they give me life! What strength I received. What beautiful instructions I learned! Oh, wisest Master! I asked him two graces and I said: my Good, answer me!

41 An interior voice told me how and || when I will get these graces. It also told me that the house of Rome will be big and many other things. But I was not very satisfied. It was true that I had maybe a quarter of an hour of much sorrow, because it seemed to me that I have not been delicate in receiving Holy Communion after being taken to some pastime when I was young.

This thought assailed me in a certain way that I was beginning to lose peace. I paused trying to bring to mind the one who directed me. Certainly if he knew it was bad, he would have not allowed me to receive Holy Communion before having confessed. Another strong temptation was that of being silent. My God – I cried – how can this be!

42 For fear of not being all right, in that period || I made a general confession.

As soon as I was appeased, other suggestions came.

  • Now I have understood, that it is you who want to upset me monster, of hell, leave me!

Fears of being deceived for lack of direction

Calm, I returned with my Good to enjoy the peace of paradise; but I felt something painful was approaching. Alas, what a pain when I am like this! And my Good kept me in the dark, that is, he kept me in a way that I was not able to see from where and from whom this painful affliction was coming. This I compare to the pains of purgatory. I feel I do not know when it will finish because the time seems doubled;

so much is the anxiety and the desire to see the end. 43 That is how I feel this tribulation approaching; I do not know how or || when it will come. A day seems to me a century, so much is the pain it brings to me. What will it be, my Good?

Will it come now or must I still stay in this languor? I feel something indescribable as if I had already received such a wound. Worse again I feel an interior convulsion because humanity is united and feels in certain moments to be an agony of death. It awakes a world of pains and when this affliction comes I remain stupid because it takes me away from my Jesus, the faculty of thought and of acting. When this state finishes, my eternal All instructs me on how I should deal with this or that affair. Then after every anxiety had ceased, I act calmly, with strength. ||

44 I did everything my Good taught me. It was successful and I found the means of doing it. But what, my Beloved, if I have no more blood. After much beating a few drops came out; but the points entered into the flesh such that for two days I had a torture and I thought the whole side could rot. But when I was thinking this, at a certain moment all the pain ceased suddenly.

My Good, the fear I have now of doing badly whatever I do having no direction makes me die; and when I think of it I do not know how my head does not break. 45 Because the desire of satisfying your commands, || the thought of making mistakes, confusing your voice with that of the enemy and then myself being the cause of some disaster in your Work, and at last what a life! I only say the least of this state of mine; which is painful and torturing.7

My Sister Anne Serafina continues to assist me and her caresses comfort me in an extraordinary way; her words give me hope of receiving everything, aware of the commitment she took for this Work, I feel extreme consolation.

46 In the sorrowful moments she comforts me with her sweetness. She is my third angel. If my God || will grant me what she promised I will die happy.

The voice of human prudence regarding penances

My God, what are you doing to me on the left side! A little more and they will remove me this same side; the movement and what happens to me is so sensible that I cannot do other than cry or make an abrupt gesture, much more than usual. I do not find anything that can relieve me:

it is true that I do nothing, but any position that I try to take, I find very painful. Today, Thursday, 20 May, with a lament I jumped from where I was leaning. I cannot say what happened, but it seemed to me that they took away the peace and that emptiness remained. At the end, there were the pains of purgatory: 47 to see and to hear my Beloved and when I seemed to be || fully in him, I returned to live on this miserable earth in which many infamies that offend the heart of Jesus take place. What a martyrdom not to have someone to say a word to! To act and to go ahead in certain spiritual matters which apparently try life, I feel I would need something different! But when I say I need and think to do otherwise I do not resist anymore and I fail. Then I think I will regret having no more time. Certainly if what I feel being suggested to me was from the devil, this unhappy monster would rejoice seeing me soon to the ground.

I begin to think of changing a bit my way of life but an expected turbulence comes together with a … ||

48 If I continue to be obstinate to do so, a sensible voice tells me:

  • Rosa, why do you fear now that my support will fail you when I sustained you for many years? Look at the past!

And it leaves me with a greater desire to do more and to increase the austerity. What havoc! But having already understood that it is the devil, because while I am in this state, I feel peace within me… It always sense those who think about caring for the body, to tell me thousand things, examples and other things; 49 in this way I am finally thrown down. One day, this battle was very strong; furthermore at that time I was without light. Only the flesh spoke. With its laments it seemed || to be in agreement with the one who played its side. They are suspicious and they cannot show anything positive about me; they say everything according to the suspicion they have, moved by the evil spirit against whatever God does.

When the peace and the voice of my Beloved returned it assured me; I started to reason and I saw everything well, but when I was in that darkness, there was nothing. It seemed that my mind was unable to reason. I struggled and I was being strangled because I had no support. 50 That moment I saw the need and I felt fully destroyed, because in complete silence in the anguishes I swallowed everything without || giving even a suspicious sigh.

God watches over his Work

On a Friday of March I was very afflicted; I went to a church where a miraculous crucifix was kept and weeping, I lamented. My tears instead of being of anguish were transformed into consolation.

Looking at him with big drops of tears:

  • Give me, my Good… I asked him for something.

In an act of caressing me, he gently said:

  • No, because you must work.

  • Patience, my Jesus, I should therefore use everything in work, in labor; if you want it I am happy. I am burning, my Good and the side is always more swollen.

What I felt inside the swelling, I cannot express.

51 One night, as usual, while I was || absorbed in God a light and a voice assured me that my God was watchful over his Work and I remained calm in the mishaps because he would have always taken care of them. I then lamented, I do not know what to say, because when I am contradicted I feel much pain and this is like an agony. I fail and I am upset, though I still do not know what will take place. I go on saying, what will happen to me?

If I see clearly what will happen, I feel a sorrow of death and rest only in it. 52 A voice not reproaching said this to me:

  • Don’t you || want to experience my afflictions? Everything that they do to the Work of the beloved St. Anne wounds me!

  • Alas, therefore, my Good when I suffer so much do you suffer too? My Good, all mine! Today I could say very

little because I felt much on this side which was very swollen.

The union with my Beloved was such that I cannot say other than: my Beloved I am dying!

The other night I was in the dark when with my open eyes. I was meditating on the side of Jesus. 53 I do not know how to express. In a moment of calm a very clear light in a form of a triangle appeared to me. || A string as big as a thumb could pass through it.

It stayed for some time before me and then it disappeared leaving me with something of paradise: serene again, full of peace and joy as if my Beloved had told me many good things. What a state this is to be always near my Good and I desire nothing else than to stay with him in contemplation and die in that state! Oh, what a sweet death would be that!

If I delay in the prayers, in the same way in the church he sends me away removing everything; I remain arid and full of temptations.

The earthquake, The door of the house of Foligno is burned

An earthquake was to come for I was feeling something very sorrowful. I was hearing but not understanding. || 54 As soon as I felt the oscillation: - Earthquake! – I said. It seemed as if it was suggested. The worst was when it ceased and all feared it would come again. I commended myself to my guardian angel, and even more to the one my Jesus gave me, the Archangel Michael. Oh, unsheathe your sword and send away from us this scourge! Let it never be repeated again!

Saying so, I kept my eyes tuned to heaven – of course in the room where I was –

I saw a group of devils all naked, in fire and they were scrambling one over the other. 55 The angel Michael was killing them with his sword || but I could only see the act of slaughtering; he did not actually touch them.

  • Drive them away for pity’s sake; they frighten me filthy as they are!

He assured me but the physical trembling did not calm. One of these devils, very big, seemed as if it was pushing down all the others.

  • My angel, why doesn’t this interior fear cease? Will the earthquake come again? No? What will happen?

I saw turbulence in the air and uproar. Afterwards it happened the same as I felt. But my angel did not want to tell me anything; what a pain! I was dying within me and though I forced 56 myself as humanly as I could, I was not able to avoid showing it externally. || Towards evening the trembling increased; what will happen to me! I saw something very sorrowful, but I could not understand anything clearly; I was very upset. Finally after midnight, they burned the door of the house. I jumped from the bed towards the window and while I was putting on the veil, I was being told everything I should do: “I am with you, be calm.”

I was, but my humanity, the body with strong apprehension feared. 57 In that moment I felt nothing because the hand of God sustained me; but after some days even the suspicion of fire brought me something internally. I believe it || resulted also from the struggle I had made and I remained the rest of the night on a chair to encourage the others, very cheerful as if nothing happened. Another grace: I suffered nothing in remaining the whole night like that praying until four in the morning, always with serene mind. After having received the Communion I went to the Prefect. The strength I had was such that I could have challenged a whole army. But in the evening seeing other devils I was very sensible for the fear of another event and it seemed to me, as if, they could do something bad. 58 Fortunately, they obeyed me. With much strength I ordered them in the name of God to go away from our house and soon they were off.8 ||

“I suffer, but I enjoy very much”

I am unable to explain the teaching, the great things that my Beloved said to me. Oh, divine Master how much sweetness you brought to my spirit! You filled it and I enjoy in the midst of so many tribulations!

I would give myself fully to the Work of my God, to be cut into pieces in the desire of consuming myself for it. I never lose the peace and the serenity of spirit for any affliction that comes. Oh, the consolations of being able to hide in the eyes of all, what I feel! These seemed to me a great grace. The swelling of the right side made me fear and the fire || devoured me; I would need to bathe.

59 In this way, sometimes I fear of being caught in the union, in the presence of people. But I am very careful and I always move. If I did not do this I could remain absorbed as it happens at night. From it I take strength and light to work the next day.

The right side and the hands remain painful and tired and the bones of the right side as if rotten.

My God showed me many things which will happen. In this way he makes known to me what the others will do to me, all the hidden things. Is not this an immense good? It still continues: I suffer but I enjoy very much. ||

60 Holy Week of 1873

Today 9 April 1873, as soon as I received Holy Communion, I remained so united with my God that I felt much joy which I cannot express. I felt as if I were being raised. I was so united with him at Mass and a half passed with the Passion without further realization of it all. I would have remained that way the whole day. My Beloved taught me many things. He fortified me and took me out of that painful state where I was: the despair. It seemed to me that I was doing everything for the devil and that the immense activity I was carrying on in 61 this Work was of greater condemnation. However, in these moments I had bright intervals, that is, spiritual communion and unexpectedly being with my Jesus || and then soon I relapsed, I did not see him and I remained in the dark. I turned everywhere to see if I could find him. My Good, therefore you do not like what I do. Why do I do it if not for you, my Beloved, and the only one who lives in me? I do not have anyone but you!

At the end I searched for relief in prayer; still worse, he was nowhere. My God! This morning I was suddenly with my Good. In the same way in such a horrible state, there were moments in which a monstrance with the Lord, that is with the Host, appeared to me; but as soon as I looked – my All – I said – and he disappeared. How much strength he gave me! 62 In the same way this morning || how much pain I felt on my back!

Today, Holy Thursday, my Good, how much I tried so that they may not realize my state! I felt like fainting! There were moments in which I could not stand on my feet. My God, for pity’s sake, do not let the creatures realize my state. I bless you all the moments for giving me this cold which is of comfort for all my torments. This covers my pain but my strength is failing me at every moment and certainly today the beatings of the discipline to bleeding will take it completely. Cover me with physical sickness, and then I will be happy.

There are moments in which the left side burns and seems to be in flames; it swells and gives me pain. 63 I would always stay in the church || before my Good, but the more I stay, the more the illness increases. My strength fails me;

the union is such that I find myself in spasms, out of my senses. My Love,- weeping I said – and even now I cannot hold back the tears, why should I always work and it is not given me to remain with you as in these days?

And in other moments: I am the donkey, who is always consumed in you.

That is what I say to him during the nights and I would never want the day to come, except to receive him and then to return to the state in which I was at night, without anybody seeing me. 64 In the midst of many eyes I prefer to work as an ass, under the yoke as an ox, provided no human creature realizes. || Something of relief, of consolation I have nothing but the night. If I remember my room of Piacenza I feel some kind of affliction such that…

My Good, what suffering this is? But for you I undergo everything! That word: “You must work”, gave me much thought. Jesus, my eternal God, I feel like fainting, with tribulations on all sides!

This was what I said to my God; the pain strangled me while I said this. Suddenly I felt that I was holding tightly to my Good. I remained like that for quite some time. 65 As I recovered I found myself very serene in the mind and the intellect full of much knowledge. I had a peace not withstanding the confusion and all the turbulence that I went through because || of the thousand thoughts and contradictions I had to sustain. Everything is little for you, my Good!

“Living without direction is a cruel torture”

A sight that terrified me in the past days was the fact that in one of our houses providence was lacking and the reason was that the girls wasted the food they were given. I saw three very big heaps; the biggest of all was the soft bread and still now when I think, I do not understand such quantity. The Lord was displeased. My God, what I felt! You know it and only you can understand it! 66 If I could have wings, I could fly to this house and || punish well these unhappy girls and teachers, but I wrote strongly enough. Oh, Father of much pity, be calmed and have pity on us!

In this way I was afflicted to see certain bad hearts. Oh, how can I live? They think that it is the labor, the tribulations. Instead it is what I see which tortures me!

Oh, to live without direction is a cruel torture. When my Good hides himself and a voice orders me and pushes me to discipline this pig! 67 I see it wasting away at every moment; I hear loud voices from all. Rather in those days it seems that they know, they exhort me to take care of my body and they make me aware of the need for me to live. On the other side || I have strong orders; if I delayed to obey, then he commanded me with sweetness and love and soon I could say, thirsty I hasten to satisfy what I understood to be his will.

As I finish, it is true that I feel strong, but if something could happen to me, soon much unrest would invade me. What can I do? Was it the devil? At the end I stay like this for some days, sometimes for hours. Later my Good comes and strengthens me with his presence and union.

“Jesus, you are my only peace”

My God! 68 There are some days that the swelling on the left side is such that I cannot explain it. In the same way I cannot explain what I feel in this part || especially in those moments of union with God. Only you, my Jesus, you are my peace, because all this that I feel gives me strength and peace to sustain with patience the great tribulations which are in the Work of God. Many times I also see that they are numberless but I do not feel many of them.

While I meet strong tribulations, at the same time I feel something gentle, sweet and I am lost in God; in that Being who attracts me to himself I remain dry in the thought. Only one occupies me, my Good, to whom I can say: I love you!

69 Certainly I have no words. I look at everything that is || human with patience and peace and I feel that in answering a honey comes from me that inebriates me.

I lamented with my Good and I said to him: you are jealous. The rest I cannot write because my All commands me to be silent: it is what I asked him, which I wanted; he promised me to agree and that he would give me everything. However the abyss of tribulations which I saw… They could not be numbered but the consolation that I felt was much that all that seemed to me nothing. 70 I saw also that I would suffer undergoing all those tortures;

nothing || frightened me because in that love I can undergo a thousand deaths without feeling the pain of all the martyrdoms. He makes everything sweet.

Today was a day of beatitude and of great light; how many things I saw in certain hearts! How many tribulations

I had today, but I cannot do other than to stay in peace. I saw the heart of a priest: how much pain! Not because of badness. But enough; I put nothing more.

“Lord give me at least sometime to prepare new

Daughters of St. Anne!”

My star moves around me; this time it is small but very bright. What a pain! He always asks for them!

  • What do you want? 71 Should another Daughter of St.

Anne leave for || paradise? Oh, for pity’s sake, a bit of pause, every moment you want one! Give me at least sometime to prepare new ones, because even this is a struggle without compare!

“For 20 years the world is not aware of my blessings and sufferings”

For some days at the end of Holy Communion a thought takes hold of me… and it seems to me that the Lord suggests to me or rather allows me to see what will happen to me.

Twice I believed it was my mind that fabricated it but it has now happened six or seven times. To whom should I ask to see if they are the product of my mind or they are sent by God?

72 I turned to my Good and with tears I asked him to release me from such thought. ||

I thought to turn to someone and reveal to him the terrible state of my spirit; but how could I? My Good, should I say what you tell me or it is the enemy who upsets me in the thanksgiving of the Holy Communion? My state is very painful! When it leaves me for some hours I say: my Beloved, only you, only you, continue to be my guide, do not allow me to say to anybody what you communicate to me. Well, for twenty years the world is not aware of my blessings and sufferings. Now that I am so emaciated, must I undergo much sorrow? Only to think about it I feel like fainting. 73 You, my Good know how much it coast me handing over certain writings and telling my state even to one || person. How can I now tell again to another? All the prayers, the concerns will not finish without being granted, because you will have compassion for me!
